---
status: active
model: claude-fable-5[1m]
effort: max
---
# Finding: The Expedition — the Lone Traversal Loop Is One Continuation Rule Plus Five Small Artifacts Away, and It Is the Keystone Event That Un-defers Everything Gated on Turn Data

## Question

From `_branch.md`: the user's #1 goal — the **lone traversal loop**: the system keeps running MVL loops by itself, sequentially, for at least 20 loops, exploring and defining a thinking space with leave-and-return behavior (explore-define → a new area appears → park it → explore another section → a later finding complements the parked area → return to it with the topology-perspective), powered by the premise that the navigational session is separate from worker sessions and can keep GROWING in a 1M-context model. Asked: **describe the operational-breakthrough sample; why it is important; what needs to be defined and refined from current logic; what components are required — what we already have, partially have.** Side-ask: a better name.

**Goal:** the operational spec, concrete enough to aim the next sessions at — failing if components get status-inflated, the walkthrough is too abstract to run, the sequential bound drifts into multihead, or the hours-old Turn Architecture is broken without declaration.

## Finding Summary

- **The goal is one rule away from what already ran today.** This very session executed seven full MVL loops sequentially over ~10 hours in one growing 1M context, never losing the thread — choosing each next move with a human keystroke between loops. The lone traversal loop replaces exactly that keystroke with a **continuation rule**: *after a worker's CONCLUDE, if no stop-condition fires and budget remains, proceed to the next see-phase.* (Honest narrowing from critique: today's session proves the **mechanical shape** — sequential loops, growing context, thread-keeping — NOT that unattended quality equals attended quality; the human also contributed mid-run catches. Measuring that gap is part of what the first run is for.)
- **The recommended name: the Expedition** — expedition(territory, goal, N≥20 turns). The user's coinage "lone traversal loop" is recorded as what it formalizes; "loop" had to go because the meta-loop already IS the cycle (committed vocabulary from this morning's Turn Architecture finding), and a bounded 20-turn run is a RUN of that loop, not itself a loop. An event-noun also can't regrow into a phantom component. **Naming is the user's seat — veto freely.**
- **Nothing in it is a new concept — it is a new RUN-SHAPE of concepts committed this week:** each turn commits per the standing validity condition (field written → choice + rationale recorded → worker launched → finding ingested → outcome slots updated); the return-move already has its canon name (*revisit*); the outputs are explfine's outputs (map + findings + frontier).
- **The mode: supervised-autonomous** — the runner pattern lifted one level. Within inquiries, canon already accepts auto-chaining with informational checkpoints and no per-step approval. Lifted: the spine chooses and continues; the human may interrupt anytime but need not approve; every choice is recorded. The gates are FED, not skipped — with one type-distinction from critique: an expedition manufactures **L2-grade calibration data** (system choices + human agree/disagree marks), while human-choice records of the Tier-1 type come from the shakedown and ordinary pre-expedition turns. Calibration value is **present-mode-conditional**: an absent-human run still yields records, but live marks beat retro-marks.
- **The mechanics: Mode B — the persistent spine + one worker-subagent per turn.** The spine session hosts see/choose/record across turns and grows only by findings and map deltas (~12K tokens/turn ⇒ ~300–350K of the 1M budget at N=20 — the user's feasibility instinct confirmed with numbers). The spine does NOT contradict the fresh-seat dial from the Turn Architecture: it is **the dial made durable** — an optional seat instance, not a mandate; field-before-choice is what validity requires and it is session-independent. Mode A (everything inline — today's proven mode) is the fallback, comfortable to ~10–15 loops. One **pretest** is required before Mode B's first real use.
- **The frontier behavior collapses into the spine's standing read:** the **ledger** (parked areas, one line each) lives in the turn record; **complement-detection is perception, not algorithm** — a context holding both the topology and the ledger notices "this touches parked area X" (this is exactly what the growing-context premise buys); **return** = the committed revisit move chosen while holding the accumulated map. No frontier algorithms are prerequisites.
- **Stop policy v1, placeholder-honest: budget-primary (N=20 as the first run's floor), signals advisory** (goal satisfied at declared resolution; ledger empty; a dry-spell of consecutive low-novelty turns). An early legitimate stop is success-with-reason, not failure.
- **The build-list is short and ordered — about 2 sessions to a shakedown, 3–4 to the full run:** (0) the indicator pre-registration file [the standing MUST — its window closes at the first committed turn]; (1) start the turn record **freeform-but-valid** (the validity condition's implied content; NO schema designed — the schema inquiry stays gated on ≥3 real turns, exactly as committed this morning); (2) the stop-v1 sentence; (3) the Mode-B pretest on a real small question; (4) the one-page expedition procedure note; (5) a **shakedown expedition** (N=5–8 on a small fresh territory — test the run-shape cheaply before the ~10-hour bet); (6) the territory decision; then the full Expedition.
- **Why it is the keystone:** one supervised run simultaneously (a) rehearses the explfine demo's exact output shape, (b) manufactures the Selector's L2-grade calibration set, (c) births traversal memory and telemetry (the measurement framework's first real data), (d) tests the Traversal Thesis's compositional-gain claim at scale, and (e) **un-defers at once every worklist item gated on turn data** — which is the precise cash value of "the operational breakthrough that lets other breakthroughs be mined."

## Finding

*Context for a reader arriving fresh: the project's era-goal (SUSTRALL — the sustained traversal loop of loops) needs the system to take many recorded "turns" — see the field, choose the next move, launch a worker inquiry, record the outcome — and climb an autonomy ladder by evidence. This morning's Turn Architecture finding settled the vocabulary (the turn, the Selector role, the field-before-choice rule, the fresh-seat dial). The user then named his #1 goal: make the system run ~20 worker loops in a row by itself. This finding turns that goal into a runnable spec.*

### 1. The definition

**The Expedition** — expedition(T, G, N): a sequence of **N ≥ 20 committed turns** over territory T toward goal G, where:

- each turn **commits** per the standing validity condition: the field is written before the pick; the choice and a one-line rationale are recorded; an outcome slot is opened; the goal/seed is carried in the record;
- **the continuation rule** (the single delta from today's practice): *after a worker's CONCLUDE — if no stop-condition fires and budget remains — the spine proceeds to the next see-phase without human input;*
- the run stops on **budget** (primary: N turns) or earlier on **advisory signals** (goal satisfied at the declared resolution; the frontier ledger empties; a dry-spell of consecutive low-novelty turns) — all placeholder-marked per the fuzziness doctrine;
- the outputs are explfine's outputs: **the map** (grown topology), **the findings** (one per turn), **the frontier** (the ledger's surviving entries) — compiled at the end into **the expedition report** (those three plus a telemetry annex). One structural echo worth noting: turn is to inquiry what expedition report is to finding — the run-level analog of the existing CONCLUDE culture.

**The mode — supervised-autonomous:** the human watches (or doesn't), may interrupt or redirect at any time, and need not approve turns. Every choice is recorded; when the human is present, live agree/disagree marks make the run a calibration instrument (absent-mode runs keep the records but degrade the calibration — presence is for calibration value, not safety). This is the within-inquiry runner pattern — informational checkpoints, interruptible, no per-step approval — applied one level up, which is why it feeds the autonomy gates rather than skipping them.

**The mechanics — Mode B primary, Mode A fallback:** the **spine** is a persistent session hosting the see/choose/record phases across all turns — warm once, then per turn: read the new finding, update the topology, check the ledger, choose and record, spawn ONE worker-subagent that runs a full `/MVLw` loop in its own context and writes its inquiry folder, ingest only the finding. Arithmetic: ~12K tokens of spine intake per turn ⇒ 20 turns ≈ 300–350K of a 1M context. The spine is **the fresh-seat dial made durable** — an instance the architecture explicitly allows, not a revision of it; per-turn fresh see-agents remain an optional quality upgrade. **Write-to-survive:** the spine writes its topology and ledger updates every turn — a resumed spine (after interruption or compaction) restores everything *written*; whatever stayed unwritten perception is honestly lost. Mode A (spine and worker in one session — today's proven mode) remains the fallback, comfortable to ~10–15 loops before context pressure.

### 2. The walkthrough (the sample the user asked for)

Warm the spine (canon + the goal + the territory seed). Then:

- **Turns 1–3 — establish.** Three worker loops on the territory's entry concepts. The map gets its first regions; each finding's open questions feed the ledger.
- **Turn 4 — discover and PARK.** Turn 3's finding revealed a new sub-area with real work in it. The spine records it in the ledger (one line + source) and — per the user's narrative — *leaves it to be*, choosing a different section instead. Checkpoint scrolls by (≤6 lines): `Turn 4/20 — chose: widen(section-C) — why: B's sub-area parked (ledger+1); C unblocks two routes — ledger: 3 open — moves so far: deepen×2 widen×2 — budget: 16 left.`
- **Turns 5–9 — explore elsewhere.** Sections C and D get explored-and-defined. The **move-distribution line** in each checkpoint keeps the choice-mix visible (an advisory threshold rides the extended checkpoints: if one move-type exceeds ~60% by turn 10 — placeholder number — the next extended checkpoint must address it; this is the guard against the run's most likely silent failure, selection monoculture).
- **Turn 10 — extended checkpoint.** Every 5th turn: the Bottleneck Dashboard glance + a full ledger review (the allocation rule's consultation cadence, mapped onto the run).
- **Turn 11 — COMPLEMENT detected, REVISIT.** Turn 10's finding on D supplies exactly the mechanism that parked area B-sub was missing. The spine — holding both the topology and the ledger in context — *notices* this (perception, not algorithm), and chooses the committed **revisit** move: re-enter the parked area *with the perspective of this topology*, exactly the user's described behavior.
- **Turn 13 — a weak turn, honestly.** A worker returns a thin finding (it happens). The outcome slot records it plainly; the next see-phase treats that area as still-open rather than covered. Degradation is visible and recovered from, not hidden.
- **Turns 14–19 — the rhythm:** explore → park → complement → revisit, the ledger breathing in and out, the map thickening.
- **Turn 20 — budget reached.** (Or earlier: ledger empty / goal satisfied / dry-spell — recorded as success-with-reason.) The spine compiles **the expedition report**: the map, the findings index, the surviving frontier, and the telemetry annex (per-turn moves, PROCEED-rates, structural-check passes — the soak-test view that shows whether quality held across 20 cycles).

What the human saw: ~20 six-line checkpoints scrolling by, four extended ones, and one report — interruptible at every seam, approving nothing.

### 3. The inventory (have / partially have / missing)

| Component | Status | The gap, if any |
|---|---|---|
| Worker runners (`/MVL`/`/MVLw`/`/aMVLw`) — full within-inquiry autonomy | **HAVE** | — |
| `/routelister` — the see-discipline with typed, scored routes + the cumulative map | **HAVE** | — |
| The Turn Architecture (turn, validity, Selector, option-vocabulary incl. *revisit*, field-before-choice, the dial) | **HAVE** (meaning layer, hours old) | — |
| Findings corpus + cross-session resume + Relationships fields | **HAVE** | — |
| The 1M-context substrate + the mechanical existence proof (this session) | **HAVE** | proof covers shape, not unattended quality |
| The within-inquiry autonomy precedent (checkpoints, no per-step approval) | **HAVE** (cultural + mechanical) | — |
| Warming doctrine | **HAVE as doctrine** | lightly practiced |
| The turn record | **PARTIAL** | meaning-complete; ZERO instances — starts freeform-but-valid (no schema; that inquiry stays gated) |
| The frontier ledger | **PARTIAL** | content exists scattered (findings' open questions, the map's unexplored areas); needs its one-line-per-area section in the turn record |
| Complement-detection | **PARTIAL** | dissolves into perception given the growing spine; needs only the standing rule: re-read the ledger at every see-phase |
| Stop policy | **PARTIAL** | concepts exist; the v1 sentence is unwritten |
| The Selector at L2/L3 | **PARTIAL** | role + staged graduation defined; mechanics gated on the very records the expedition produces |
| Worker-as-subagent separation (Mode B) | **PARTIAL** | the mechanism exists in the substrate; never exercised — hence the pretest |
| The expedition procedure note (the continuation rule + checkpoint format + stop + abort/resume) | **MISSING** | one page |
| The indicator pre-registration file | **MISSING** | the standing MUST; its window closes at the first committed turn |
| The stop-v1 sentence; the ledger section; the pretest | **MISSING** | each is minutes-to-hours of work |

### 4. The ordered build-list (what must be defined/refined, and the distance)

0. **The indicator pre-registration file** — BEFORE anything else (the standing MUST from the Traversal Thesis finding; the expedition's first committed turn creates traversal memory, which closes the window).
1. **Start the turn record, freeform-but-valid** — each turn writes the validity condition's implied content (field-reference, choice, rationale, outcome slot, goal, ledger lines) in whatever shape comes naturally. **No schema is designed** — the record-schema inquiry stays gated on ≥3 real turns, exactly as this morning's architecture finding committed; these records are what will feed it.
2. **The stop-v1 sentence** — budget-primary, three advisory signals, placeholder-marked.
3. **The Mode-B pretest** — one worker-as-subagent running one full loop on a real small question (even the test yields a usable finding). Checks the worker's internal sequential depth survives the subagent boundary.
4. **The expedition procedure note** — ONE page: the continuation rule, the ≤6-line checkpoint format (with the move-distribution line), the every-5th extended checkpoint, stop conditions, abort/resume. A runner-level addendum, not a new architecture.
5. **The shakedown expedition** — N=5–8 turns on a small fresh territory: test the run-SHAPE (parking, complements, the report) before betting the event budget. Its turns, human-choosable, also carry Tier-1-type records.
6. **The territory decision** for the full run (can be made anytime in parallel): the project's own frontier (richest priors; explfine(self)-flavored; self-referential) vs a fresh bounded external territory (the acceptance-grade demo shape; cleaner evidence). Recommendation: own-frontier for the first full run, fresh-external for the second.

**Distance: ~2 sessions to the shakedown; ~3–4 sessions to the full Expedition.** The run itself: 8–10 hours wall-clock, resumable across sittings by construction.

### 5. Why this is the keystone (the importance argument)

One supervised expedition simultaneously delivers five things, each to a named waiting consumer:

1. **The explfine demo's rehearsal** — the run's outputs ARE the acceptance test's output shape (map + findings + frontier with declared coverage).
2. **The Selector's calibration set** — ~20 recorded system-choices with human marks = **L2-grade data** (the type distinction matters: the shakedown's human-choice turns carry the Tier-1 type; the expedition's system-choice turns carry the L2 type — together they fuel both gates).
3. **Telemetry birth** — traversal memory finally exists; nearly every starved measurement in the self-improvement-rate framework presupposes exactly these records.
4. **The compositional-gain test at scale** — the Traversal Thesis's across-call claim (selection + memory compound) gets its first 20-point dataset, with the soak-stats showing whether quality holds unattended.
5. **Mass un-deferral** — verified item by item: the Selector graduation gate, the meta-loop skeleton refresh (≥3 turns), the process-layer inquiry, the record-schema inquiry, and the retention checks ALL gate on turn data the run produces in one event. *This is the precise sense in which the user's "operational breakthrough which will enable other breakthroughs to be mined" is true: every deferred item queued on turn-data un-defers at once.*

**The honest caveats:** the run concentrates risk in the territory choice and the event budget (~20× a single loop's spend; ~10 hours) — which is what the shakedown de-risks; a failed expedition still yields its records (the calibration data survives the disappointment); and the architecture's failure mode remains stagnation (turns stop being recorded), not breakage.

### 6. The name

**The Expedition** (recommended): an event-noun — it denotes a RUN and cannot regrow into a phantom component (the anti-regrowth naming test from this morning's architecture finding); the metaphor pays its way (parked frontiers = supply caches; the growing map; leave-and-return; the report at the end); usage is natural ("run a 20-turn expedition over X"). The user's coinage **lone traversal loop** is recorded as the formalized original; "loop" specifically collides with committed vocabulary (the meta-loop IS the cycle; this is a bounded run OF it). The naming referent was adjudicated: the OPERATION needed the name — the explore-define act keeps its canon name (explfine), and "thinking space" stays settled vocabulary. **Veto standing — naming is the user's seat.**

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** the Turn Architecture — the turn + validity condition; the Selector role with staged graduation; the fresh-seat dial; launching as plumbing; the gated record-schema and L3-session questions.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_14-00__metaloop_orchestrator_role_architecture_from_scratch/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, EXTENDED. **Evidence:** the expedition is N committed turns under the unchanged validity condition; the spine is an optional seat-instance the architecture explicitly allows (continuity demands it), with the dial intact as the per-turn fresh-eyes option; critique additionally PROTECTED the architecture's own gate — the build-list's record step was reworded to freeform-but-valid precisely so the gated schema inquiry stays gated.

- **Commitment:** SUSTRALL's path-to-achievement tiers and explfine as the acceptance capability.
  - **Source:** `docs/canon/sustained_traversal_loop_of_loops.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed (compressed, not skipped). **Evidence:** the expedition compresses Tiers 1–2 into one event while feeding the same gates (typed records); the explfine demo's output shape is exactly the expedition report; supervised-autonomous ≠ ungated Level-3 (the human is present, interruptible; every choice recorded).

- **Commitment:** the indicator pre-registration MUST — the criteria file before the first traversal-memory artifact.
  - **Source:** the Traversal Thesis finding (`devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_10-34__traversal_path_bias_thesis_and_consciousness_emergence/finding.md`).
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed and made urgent. **Evidence:** the expedition's first committed turn CREATES traversal memory; the build-list places the file at step 0, before everything.

- **Commitment:** the allocation rule — climb-default; tripwires; the every-~5-inquiries consultation cadence.
  - **Source:** the allocation finding (`devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_11-15__mvl_good_enough_threshold_vs_building_higher_blocks/finding.md`) and its canon subsection.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed. **Evidence:** the expedition is the climb-default's fullest expression; the consultation cadence maps onto the every-5th extended checkpoint; tripwires stay live mid-run (a consumer-failure = fix-grade pause, then resume).

- **Commitment:** the five stop-signals stay deliberately fuzzy — no invented formulas.
  - **Source:** `docs/canon/what_is_meaningful_traversal.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed. **Evidence:** stop-v1 is budget-primary with signals advisory and placeholder-marked; critique killed the signals-only stop from the other direction (an unbounded run on advisory instruments).

Pattern-note: all five confirmed — but not frictionlessly: the architecture commitment was confirmed partly BY CORRECTING this inquiry's own draft (the freeform-record catch), and the existence-proof and gate-fuel claims were narrowed/typed rather than waved through. The frame was challenged where it needed to be.

## Next Actions

### MUST (the pre-run checklist, in order)

- **What:** Create the indicator pre-registration file.
  **Who:** the user + assistant, one short session.
  **Gate:** observable — BEFORE the first committed turn anywhere (shakedown included); the window closes at that turn.
  **Why:** the Traversal Thesis finding's standing MUST; expeditions create exactly the artifact that closes it.

- **What:** Start the turn record (freeform-but-valid: field-ref, choice, rationale, outcome slot, goal, ledger lines) + write the stop-v1 sentence + the one-page expedition procedure note.
  **Who:** one working session.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — before the shakedown.
  **Why:** the three smallest missing artifacts; no schema design (the record-schema inquiry stays gated on ≥3 real turns).

- **What:** Run the Mode-B pretest — one worker-as-subagent executing one full `/MVLw` loop on a real small question.
  **Who:** one short session.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — before the shakedown (Mode A is the fallback if it fails).
  **Why:** the one untested mechanism in the whole plan; checks worker depth survives the subagent boundary.

- **What:** Run the **shakedown expedition** — N=5–8 turns, small fresh territory, human present.
  **Who:** the user (choosing) + the spine (executing) — supervised.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — after the items above; ~one sitting.
  **Why:** tests the run-shape (parking, complements, revisit, the report) before the ~10-hour event budget; its human-choosable turns also carry Tier-1-type records.

### COULD

- **What:** Confirm or veto the name (the Expedition) and the territory recommendation (own-frontier first, fresh-external second).
  **Who:** the user — one line each.
  **Gate:** observable — whenever read.
  **Why:** the procedure note's wording uses the settled name; the territory decision can be made anytime in parallel.

- **What:** Run absent-human expeditions (overnight runs).
  **Who:** the spine, alone.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — after at least one present-mode expedition establishes the calibration baseline.
  **Why:** records still accrue; calibration value is degraded (retro-marks) — tolerable later, wasteful first.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** The cross-session carrier (Mode C — scripts/cron for runs no human session hosts).
  **Gate:** revival trigger — when expeditions need to outlive sessions entirely (post-L2).
  **Why (if revived):** removes the last human dependency from the run's mechanics.

- **What:** The turn-record v1 schema; the L3 Selector-session question; the compare/Evaluator design; mechanized complement-detection.
  **Gate:** revival triggers unchanged from their source findings (≥3 real turns; recorded-turn data; multihead reality; L3+ scale).
  **Why (if revived):** each becomes designable exactly on the data expeditions produce.

## Reasoning

**Why "one rule away" is the honest frame and not hype.** Every element of the user's description resolved to something that already exists under a committed name: the loops (worker runners), the seeing (routelister + the map), the choosing (the Selector role), the return-move (*revisit*), the outputs (explfine's bundle). The only behavioral delta between today's session and the described goal is who continues after a finding lands — a keystroke vs a rule. The critique then narrowed the claim where it overreached: the existence proof covers the mechanical shape; attended-vs-unattended quality is exactly what the first run's soak-stats measure.

**Why supervised-autonomous and not L3 autonomy.** The gates bind unsupervised trust, and they are fed by recorded choices. A watched, interruptible, fully-recorded run removes only the per-turn approval — the same move the within-inquiry runners made long ago — while manufacturing the calibration data the gates need. The typed-fuel distinction (L2-grade system-choice records vs Tier-1-type human-choice records) keeps the gate arithmetic honest.

**Why Mode B with a pretest, not Mode B by assertion.** The spine+worker-subagent mechanics exist in the substrate but have never been exercised; the pretest converts an assumption into a checked fact for the cost of one small real inquiry. Mode A's proven ~7-loop run is the fallback that keeps the goal alive even if the pretest fails.

**Significant kills.** *Keeping "loop" in the operation's name* — killed: the meta-loop IS the cycle (hours-old commitment); a bounded run of the loop cannot also be "a loop" without re-tangling the names the same day they were untangled. *Frontier algorithms as prerequisites* — killed: at N≈20 with a growing spine, complement-detection is perception over a held ledger; mechanization is an L3+ future. *Signals-primary stop* — killed twice (once per direction): placeholder signals as the sole stop invents the formula canon forbids; no budget at all puts an unbounded run on advisory instruments. *The schema-now reading of the record step* — killed by critique: freeform-but-valid records honor the architecture's own gate. *The roguelike framing* — killed by the analogy-inflation guard.

**The self-reference handling.** The system spec'd its own autonomy run. Guards: every headline claim ended CONDITIONED (mechanical shape, not attended quality; L2-grade, not generic gate fuel; written-survives, not held; present-mode calibration) — and the conditioning came from prosecutions that cut the package's own claims three times. A spec whose claims are conditioned is one an event budget can be spent on.

## Open Questions

### Monitoring

- **Does the pretest pass?** Observable: one worker-as-subagent loop returning a structurally-complete finding.
- **Does quality hold unattended?** Observable: the shakedown's and first expedition's soak-stats (per-turn PROCEED-rates, structural passes) vs today's attended baseline.
- **Does the move-distribution stay diverse?** Observable: the checkpoint tallies; the ~60%-by-turn-10 advisory threshold (placeholder) at extended checkpoints.

### Blocked

- **The record schema, the L3 session question, the compare design** — blocked on the very turn-data the expeditions produce (their gates unchanged).

### Research Frontiers

# Finding: Routelister Is Not Weak — It Is Alone. The Selector's Field Was Always Composite, and the Third Share Has Been You

## Question

From `_branch.md`: the user senses "the main thing we are missing" is routelister's capability being "not so strong as my mind" — looking at the inquiries folder's sequential chains, his actual next-inquiry moves are often *challenging an idea* or *diving deep into a non-obvious part*, and he suspects routelister has big limitations. The ask, with explicit sequencing: **define the problem better, and catalog what KINDS of routes routelister might fail to list — understand first; solving comes later.**

**Goal:** a diagnosis the future fix inquiry can consume as requirements — empirically grounded in the corpus's actual chains, with routelister's spec read fresh, listing-failures kept distinct from choosing-differences, and no fix designed.

## Finding Summary

- **Your instinct is confirmed — and relocated.** Routelister is not defective (its spec, read in full, is coherent and self-consistent) and not the wrong tool. It is **alone**: it has been silently treated as the WHOLE producer of the next-move field, when the field you actually choose from every turn has three sources — **routelister's enumerated concept-routes ⊕ the Selector's own control-options (stop/widen/merge/revisit…) ⊕ silent supplements your mind adds.** The third share has no organ. It has been you, every single turn.
- **The gap, operationally: three operations your mind runs at choose-time that enumeration deliberately does not.** **COLLIDE** — outside knowledge meets the finding (your gradient objection: "reasoning evaluates before acting ≈ slope" — that content lives nowhere in the inquiry's folder); **GENERATE** — invent a candidate alternative (your "list strong meta-ambiguities instead of meta-questions" reframe); **REBIND** — shift the territory's scope at will (your cross-corpus "code is pregnant" perception; bringing optimization theory in). Routelister ENUMERATES what the given territory contains — by spec: *"it does not invent directions that the territory does not contain."*
- **The precise form of the miss is slot-vs-load.** The spec HAS the verbs — TEST ("validate a concept against evidence") and REFRAME ("adopt a different framing") — so unloaded SLOTS ("test the family verdict") are listable. What cannot be enumerated is the LOAD: the actual counter-argument, the actual candidate framing. Unloaded slots rarely move a chooser; the loaded rounds are what changed this project's course.
- **The missed-KINDS catalog (the thing you asked for): four hard-miss kinds + one half-listable.** (1) **Loaded-challenge routes** — the loaded form of TEST (anchor: the gradient objection); (2) **invented-alternative routes** — the loaded form of REFRAME (anchor: the MQ→ambiguities proposal); (3) **gestalt routes** — cross-corpus patterns needing a wider territory than any caller gives (anchor: "code is pregnant"); (4) **import routes** — outside theory brought to bear (anchor: the gradient-descent correlation probe). Plus (5) **status-probe routes**, half-listable: perceiving "this canon claim was never re-verified" is enumerable at corpus binding with a skeptical sweep; DECIDING the regrade stays yours (anchor: the canon demotion).
- **Two of the things you'd expect on that list are NOT capability misses — they are usage gaps.** Within-territory tension-flags ("the README and the implementation disagree — reconcile") are already in the spec as concept-space divergence-flagging; and quote/cascade depth-dives (one of YOUR two named examples) are exactly what a concept-space depth run over a finding's parts produces. These go unlisted because nobody runs those modes between inquiries — not because routelister can't.
- **Three more are by-design facts, not failures:** control-moves belong to the Selector's option-vocabulary; goal-formation is your retained seat; operator-state (curiosity, energy) is Selector input. They stay visible in the picture so the field's compositeness stays explicit — but they don't indict routelister.
- **The causes, located:** (i) *identity-level* — enumerate-not-invent is routelister's hallucination guard; **the eye should not bite** — the missing kinds need a different organ, not a loosened enumerator; (ii) *stance-level* — the sweep is never ASKED "what is suspicious here"; (iii) *binding-level* — callers hand it one inquiry's folder while gestalts live at corpus scope; (iv) **the positional omission** (the load-bearing discovery, corrected by critique from an absolute claim): the harness DOES contain collision and generation — td-critique's prosecution collides, innovate generates — but only INSIDE inquiries, aimed at candidates. **Nothing aims those operations at the between-inquiry route-field.** The fix question is therefore partly a *repositioning* question.
- **The stake, sized as a testable hypothesis:** the corpus's course-change events (the answer-shape correction, the ambiguities reframe, the canon demotion, the gradient corrigendum, the Expedition goal) look supplement-heavy, while routine progress is enumeration-heavy — **supplements appear low-frequency but high-consequence**. Marked as a HYPOTHESIS (the inflection list risks selection bias), with its test attached: the retrospective tally below.
- **The measurement exists already — two parts.** **(A) Retrospective, available today:** the corpus's 78 CONTINUES-FROM chains record your actual next-moves verbatim (findings carry Source Inputs and revision triggers); one session of classifying every chain-step against the kind-catalog yields the gap's base rate and tests the punctuation hypothesis. **(B) Prospective:** during expeditions, any move you inject at a checkpoint gets a one-line **supplement tag** (kind-named) in the turn record — the gap measured live, riding artifacts that already exist.
- **For the Expedition: proceed, eyes open.** Supervised mode keeps your supplement channel alive (interrupts). The named risk for absent-human runs: the third share vanishes — the run keeps the gradualism and misses the punctuations, while soak-stats look fine (**the confirmation-shape risk**). The first expedition doubles as this gap's measurement instrument.
- **The seed for the fix inquiry (named, not designed; explicitly un-ranked):** pole 1 — **build/reposition the organ** (a between-inquiry collision/generation capability; precedent: red teams are always their own unit; reuse hint: the in-harness critique machinery — the same reuse pattern the Expedition finding noted for compare); pole 2 — **formalize the centaur** (you remain the supplement organ permanently; autonomy runs on enumerable moves; cost: supervision forever, between-inquiry autonomy capped near Level 2). **The retrospective tally is the decision criterion** — if supplements are rare but carry most inflections, the organ pole's value is high; if not, centaur suffices.

## Finding

*Context for a reader arriving fresh: routelister is the project's "see" discipline — given a territory (typically a finished inquiry's artifacts) and a goal, it enumerates typed routes ("directions one could take"), which the chooser (the Selector role — today the human) picks from. The Turn Architecture made the written route-field load-bearing (a turn is valid only if the field is written before the pick), and the Expedition (the user's #1 goal — ~20 autonomous sequential loops) will choose from this field on every turn. The user asked whether routelister can actually produce the field his own mind produces.*

### 1. The gap defined: three operations, one distinction, one architecture statement

**What enumeration is:** routelister sweeps a bounded territory and casts the concepts IT CONTAINS as typed routes, under a fixed nine-verb vocabulary — and, by deliberate spec identity, *"does not invent directions that the territory does not contain"* (the hallucination guard), receives its goal rather than forming one, and produces no control-flow moves. These exclusions are protective, not defects.

**What your mind adds at choose-time — the three operations:**
- **Collision:** your knowledge meets the artifact and produces a loaded objection. The territory cannot contain it, because half of the collision lives in you.
- **Generation:** you invent a candidate alternative that exists nowhere until you say it.
- **Rebinding:** you change what counts as the territory — jumping from one inquiry's folder to the whole corpus, or to an outside discipline — and perceive at the new scope.

**Slot-vs-load:** the spec's TEST and REFRAME verbs mean the unloaded FORMS of challenge and reframe are listable ("TEST the verdict" / "REFRAME this concept"). The LOADED forms — the actual objection, the actual candidate — require collision or generation. An unloaded slot rarely moves a chooser.

**The composite field (the architecture statement this corpus never wrote down):** what the Selector actually chooses from = enumerated concept-routes (routelister) + control-options (the Selector's own vocabulary: go-deeper, widen, different-approach, merge, revisit, unblock, stop) + supplement-routes (today: the human). The two vocabularies do not collide — routelister's verbs prescribe engagement with CONCEPTS; the Selector's moves steer the PROCESS. The gap stayed invisible precisely because you topped the field up by hand every turn. *(A gated candidate one-liner for canon, awaiting the naming veto and the user's seat: "The Selector's field is composite: enumerated concept-routes + control-options + supplement-routes — the third share currently human.")*

**One honest symmetry line:** the human also misses kinds routelister catches — systematic sweeps list the unglamorous due-diligence routes (consolidation, maintenance TEST-slots) that salience-driven attention skips *(plausible-typical, not verbatim-anchored: the corpus records what you picked, not what you skipped — observing the skip-class is part of what the tally is for)*. The composite field needs both organs; this diagnosis ranks neither.

### 2. The missed-KINDS catalog

**Four hard-miss kinds** (each: what it is · the operation it needs · its corpus anchor · its best available substitute):

1. **Loaded-challenge routes** — an objection with substance against a concluded position. Needs COLLISION. Anchor: *"u said [the chat line]… but if there is reasoning in a system, we can evaluate actions before taking them… I think you are missing some underlying logic"* (the gradient objection — which produced a corrigendum and a refined family verdict). Substitute today: the unloaded TEST slot. *(Slot-pairing: this is the loaded form of TEST.)*
2. **Invented-alternative routes** — a novel candidate framing/design offered against the current one. Needs GENERATION. Anchor: *"I have another take on MQs — instead of meta questions, we can actually list the strong meta ambiguities… I feel like this is a better fit"* (which became articulate_simple's committed 2-shape design). Substitute: the unloaded REFRAME slot. *(The loaded form of REFRAME.)*
3. **Gestalt routes** — a pattern visible only across many artifacts at once. Needs REBINDING. Anchor: *"when you inspect the disciplines in this project… 'code is pregnant'… there is a hidden abstraction"* (which produced the manifest/checker design). Substitute: caller re-binding only (no run mode reaches corpus scope unless the caller hands it the corpus).
4. **Import routes** — an outside body of knowledge brought to bear. Needs COLLISION with external corpora. Anchor: the gradient-descent correlation probe (which produced the algorithm-family canon doc). Substitute: none.

**One half-listable kind:** **status-probe routes** — "this record's authority deserves re-examination." The PERCEPTION half (staleness, never-re-verified claims) is enumerable as a TEST-slot at corpus binding with a skeptical sweep; the REGRADE half (deciding canon is demoted) is the human's. Anchor: *"be careful to not take preexisting knowledge as canon, even in canon folder files."*

**Two usage-gaps — NOT capability misses:** within-territory tension-flags (the spec's own concept-space mode flags divergences as "high-value epistemic routes"); and quote/cascade depth-dives — **one of your own two named examples lands here**: "dive deep into a not-so-obvious part" is what a concept-space depth run over a finding's parts produces. These are unlisted in practice because the modes aren't run between inquiries, not because the capability is absent.

**Three by-design facts — kept visible, off the failure list:** control-moves (the Selector's vocabulary); goal-formation (your retained seat — the lone-loop goal could never be a route); operator-state moves (Selector input). Counting these against routelister would re-tangle the kind-table the Turn Architecture settled.

### 3. The causes, located (not fixed)

- **Identity-level (protective):** enumerate-not-invent excludes loads, inventions, and imports — rightly. An enumerator that invents is a hallucination engine. **The eye should not bite**; the missing kinds need a different organ, not a loosened routelister.
- **Stance-level:** nothing ever asks the sweep to be skeptical. TEST exists as a verb, but the sweep's question is "what is here," never "what is wrong here" — so even the enumerable skeptical content (tension-flags, status-probes) goes unlisted in practice.
- **Binding-level:** callers hand routelister one inquiry's folder by default; gestalts live at corpus scope. A seam/caller cause, not a spec cause.
- **The positional omission (the diagnosis's sharpest line, corrected by its own critique):** the harness CONTAINS the missing operations — td-critique's prosecution is collision; innovate's generators generate — but only *inside* inquiries, aimed at candidates. **Nothing aims collision or generation at the between-inquiry route-field.** The architectural question the fix inquiry inherits is therefore partly *repositioning*, not pure invention — and this is the second independent pointer toward reusing critique machinery at a new layer (the Expedition finding noted compare-as-possible-critique-variant). A pattern, recorded; not a design.

### 4. The stakes, the measurement, and the seed

**The punctuation hypothesis (motivating, testable, honestly tagged):** the project's course-change events look supplement-heavy — the 2-shape correction (loaded challenge), the ambiguities reframe (invented alternative), the canon demotion (status regrade), the gradient corrigendum (loaded challenge + import), the Expedition goal (goal-move) — while routine progress (deepen/develop/consolidate chains) is enumeration-shaped. If true, supplements are **low-frequency, high-consequence**: an expedition without them keeps the gradualism and misses the punctuations, while per-turn soak-stats look fine — **the confirmation-shape risk** for absent-human runs. Tagged as a hypothesis because the inflection list was assembled by the diagnostician (selection-bias risk); its test is part A below.

**The measurement (two parts, no new infrastructure):**
- **A — the retrospective tally (available today, ≈ one session):** classify every step of the corpus's 78 CONTINUES-FROM chains against the kind-catalog (the per-step move text already exists — findings preserve Source Inputs verbatim and revision triggers). Yields: the supplement base-rate, the per-kind frequencies, and the punctuation hypothesis's verdict (do supplement-kinds cluster at course-changes?).
- **B — prospective supplement tags:** during expeditions, any human-injected move at a checkpoint gets one line in the turn record, tagged with its kind from this catalog. The taxonomy IS the classification rubric; the records ride artifacts the Expedition already writes.

**For the Expedition:** proceed as designed — supervised mode keeps the supplement channel open (your interrupts are the third share, live); the run doubles as measurement; postponing would starve the diagnosis of exactly the data it needs.

**The seed for the fix inquiry (named, un-ranked; the user opens it when ready):**
- **Pole 1 — build/reposition the organ:** a between-inquiry collision/generation capability producing loaded-challenge, invented-alternative, gestalt, and import routes into the field. Precedent: red teams are institutionally their own unit, never merged into the surveyor. Reuse hint: the in-harness critique/innovation machinery (the positional omission says the operations exist). Cost: a design inquiry + calibration before its output is trusted in fields.
- **Pole 2 — formalize the centaur:** the human remains the supplement organ permanently; autonomy runs on enumerable moves; supplements arrive via interrupts and turn-seeds. Cost: supervision forever; between-inquiry autonomy effectively capped near Level 2; the explfine-at-scale vision narrows.
- **The decision criterion:** part A's numbers. High-consequence-and-present → the organ pole earns its build. Rare-and-replaceable → centaur suffices. The tally converts the fix from taste to data.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** routelister's spec — enumerate-not-invent; goal-exogenous; no control-flow; divergence-flagging in concept-space mode; the nine-verb vocabulary.
  - **Source:** `cognitive_harness/routelister/SKILL.md` + `references/routelister.md` (read in full this inquiry).
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed in full. **Evidence:** every missed kind traces to a deliberate identity property, a caller choice, or a missing other organ — none to a spec self-violation; the spec's own divergence-flag covers within-territory tensions (which forced the taxonomy's K1a/K1b split); the protective rationale (hallucination guard) is upheld as load-bearing for the fix inquiry's constraints.

- **Commitment:** the Turn Architecture — routelister as the see-discipline; field-before-choice; the Selector's option-vocabulary; the kind-table's seats.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_14-00__metaloop_orchestrator_role_architecture_from_scratch/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, EXTENDED. **Evidence:** the two vocabularies resolve as different layers (engagement-verbs over concepts vs control-moves over the process — no collision); the field-before-choice rule gains content: the FIELD was never routelister's output alone — the composite-field statement extends the architecture without revising any seat; the by-design boundary (goal = human's; control = Selector's) is actively protected by the taxonomy's splits.

- **Commitment:** the Expedition — the run chooses from routelister's field; complement-detection-as-perception; supervised-autonomous mode; the soak-stats.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_14-41__lone_traversal_loop_operational_breakthrough/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed but frame revised. **Evidence:** the finding never promised self-challenging runs, and its mechanics stand; but its field was implicitly treated as complete — the confirmation-shape risk now has a named mechanism (the vanishing third share), the supervised mode acquires a second job (the supplement channel), and the soak-stats caveat gains content (they measure per-turn quality, not field completeness). The run's design needs NO change; its risk register does.

- **Commitment:** one-enumerator / two-controllers (in role form).
  - **Source:** the loop-control design history, as re-derived by the Turn Architecture finding.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed and EXTENDED. **Evidence:** the architecture has one enumerator, two controllers — **and zero between-inquiry collision/generation organs** (corrected by critique to a POSITIONAL omission: the operations exist within inquiries — critique's prosecution, innovation's generators — but are never aimed at the route-field). The extension names what the original vocabulary had no word for.

Pattern-note: all four confirmed, two extended — and the inquiry's own central claim (the absolute omission) was CORRECTED mid-pipeline by its own method (sweeping the harness for the operation), which is the inheritance-and-self-test culture working in both directions.

## Next Actions

### MUST

None — the diagnosis is complete as understanding; the user's sequencing explicitly defers action.

### COULD

- **What:** Run the **retrospective tally** (part A): classify the 78 chain-steps against the kind-catalog; report base-rate, per-kind frequencies, and the punctuation hypothesis's verdict.
  **Who:** one session (assistant executes; the catalog is the rubric).
  **Gate:** observable — whenever the user says go; highest value BEFORE the fix inquiry.
  **Why:** converts this diagnosis into numbers using data that already exists; supplies the fix inquiry's decision criterion.

- **What:** Add the **supplement-tag line** to the Expedition's procedure note when that note is written (already a MUST in the Expedition's build-list).
  **Who:** rides the existing pre-run checklist item.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — the procedure note's drafting.
  **Why:** part B of the measurement; one line, no new artifact.
  **Depends-on:** the Expedition finding's MUST "the one-page expedition procedure note". GATED — the tag rides that note.

- **What:** Open the **fix inquiry** ("what closes the supplement gap — organ/repositioning vs centaur?") with this finding + the tally as inputs.
  **Who:** the user (a new `/aMVLw`).
  **Gate:** condition-bound — after the tally (the seed's criterion wants the numbers); earlier if the user prefers taste-first.
  **Why:** the user's own "we must solve this," sequenced exactly as he asked.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** The composite-field one-liner's canon attachment.
  **Gate:** revival trigger — the naming veto resolves AND the SUSTRALL canon's component-section replacement (already proposed) executes; rides that same pass.
  **Why (if revived):** canon currently implies the field is routelister's output; one sentence keeps the architecture honest.

- **What:** A skeptical-stance / corpus-binding run option for routelister's CALLERS (the usage-gap closers).
  **Gate:** revival trigger — the fix inquiry (they are fix-space items, kept out of this diagnosis by the user's bound).
  **Why (if revived):** the two cheapest improvements — they unlock K1a tension-flags and status-probe perception with zero new capability.

## Reasoning

**Why the relocation (alone, not weak) is the load-bearing move.** The user's framing placed the defect inside routelister; the spec, read fresh, is self-consistent, and every observed miss traces to a deliberate identity property (protective), a stance never requested, a binding never widened, or an organ that exists nowhere. Calling routelister weak would aim the fix at the wrong target — and the most likely bad fix (telling the enumerator to invent) would destroy its hallucination guard. The honest formulation — a solitary organ doing a plural job — preserves the tool and names the absence.

**Why the taxonomy splits four ways instead of listing eight failures.** Three surfaced candidates (control-moves, goal-formation, operator-state) are moves the architecture deliberately houses elsewhere — counting them as routelister failures would re-tangle the day-old kind-table. Two more (tension-flags, depth-dives) are in the spec already — counting them as misses would slander quotable text; they are usage gaps, and one of the user's own examples lands there (stated in his favor: the capability exists; the practice doesn't run it).

**Significant kills and self-corrections.** *The quality-knob explanation* (better prompts close the gap) — killed: the hard kinds differ in KIND; no sweep quality produces content that lives outside the territory. *The flat eight-item failure list* — killed by the by-design boundary. *The absolute-omission claim* — corrected by the critique's sweep to POSITIONAL (the harness collides and generates within inquiries; nothing aims it at the field) — the diagnosis's own confirmed-absent method applied against its own central claim. *The kind-name "reframe routes"* — killed by the package's own slot/load logic (it collided with the REFRAME verb and would have re-created the confusion it diagnoses). *The punctuation insight as a claim* — downgraded to a hypothesis with its test attached (selection-bias risk named). *The immunology analogy* — killed by the analogy-inflation guard (code review's two channels is the one analogy: linters enumerate; human reviewers collide; the industry added channels rather than sharpening linters alone).

**Self-reference handling.** The system diagnosed the organ that feeds its own autonomy ambitions, with an obvious flattery risk in both directions (excusing the tool; inflating the human). Guards: the spec quoted against the taxonomy's first draft (forcing the K1a split); the symmetry line (the human misses kinds the sweep catches — honestly tagged as not-yet-measured); the prosecution cutting the three most self-serving claims (the omission's absoluteness, the punctuation's evidence, the names' cleverness); and the diagnosis crediting the human's invisible work as an ORGAN-ROLE to be measured, not a compliment.

## Open Questions

### Monitoring

- **The supplement base-rate** — observable: the retrospective tally's numbers (78 chain-steps classified).
- **The punctuation hypothesis** — observable: do supplement-kinds cluster at course-change steps in the tally?
- **Live supplement frequency** — observable: the tags during the first expedition (how often does the human actually inject, and which kinds?).

### Blocked

- **The fix adjudication (organ/reposition vs centaur)** — blocked on the tally by the seed's own criterion (or unblocked by user preference).

### Research Frontiers

- **Can collision/generation output be made field-grade?** (Loaded challenges from a machine organ would need calibration before a Selector should weight them — the trust problem the fix inquiry inherits; no precedent in-corpus.)

### Refinement Triggers

- **If the tally shows supplements are frequent-and-low-consequence** (the punctuation hypothesis fails): the gap's priority drops; the centaur pole strengthens; this finding's stakes section revises.
- **If a usage change (skeptical stance / corpus binding) is adopted by callers** and the unlisted-but-listable kinds start appearing in fields: the taxonomy's half-listable and usage-gap rows update from "unrun" to measured.
- **If the naming veto lands on "orchestrator"** rather than "Selector": this finding's vocabulary re-words with the architecture's; nothing structural changes.


# Finding: Adopt the Exhaust Step — Every Loop Emits Its Route-Map at CONCLUDE, and the Navigational Session Becomes One Integrate-Run Over the Leaves

## Question

From `_branch.md`: the user's proposal — why not run routelister after each loop, on that inquiry's outputs (producing its `routelister.md` + `_route.md`)? The navigational session then becomes "just about compiling" per-inquiry maps into a bigger directional map ("running routelister in root mode? or in direction mode?"). Claimed: significant simplification, a constant route list in the projectbase, and fresh-focus accuracy (running just after critique). Explicitly open: *"i guess they should only generate downstream routes… i am not so sure about this."*

**Goal:** the design adjudication — verdict with reasons, the runner-step spec text-ready, the navigational compile design with the mode answer, the downstream adjudication, and the consequence trace — at process layer, with routelister's own spec untouched and all edits as proposals.

## Finding Summary

- **Verdict: ADOPT-REFINED.** Your proposal is spec-legal by construction (routelister's own self-containment clause says "how a caller uses its output is the caller's concern" — this is a CALLER composition, and the discipline stays position-free), it has a working precedent (a per-inquiry `_route.md` from June 3 — 14 typed identities over a finding, exactly this pattern run manually once), it closes the two **usage-gaps** the routelister-gap finding named hours ago (the "unrun modes" become runner-automatic), and it feeds your #1 goal directly (the Expedition's see-phase becomes read+compile).
- **The step, text-ready (a RUNNER addition, immediately after CONCLUDE):** invoke routelister with territory = `finding.md` and goal received from the finding's own Question/Goal section — *"advance from this finding toward [the finding's Goal], **including tests and refinements of this finding itself**"* (the stance nudge) — outputs land in the inquiry folder per the spec's own two-file contract. **Non-blocking:** if the run fails, one History line and the inquiry stays COMPLETE (re-runnable later) — and the failure has a DETECTOR: the next integrate-run's fallback sweep flags leaf-less findings, so tolerance can't quietly become abandonment. `conclude.md` stays untouched (it's shared across runners); the step is proposed for `/aMVLw` + `/MVLw` (other runners your call).
- **Your mode question answers itself in your own words:** "not running routelister for each inquiry but reading them and running routelister in **root mode**" — exactly. The navigational session runs ONE **integrate-run**: root/breadth mode, index-extending — per-inquiry maps and findings are its TERRITORY (**the leaves**), and a corpus-scope master index is its own `_route.md` (**the canopy**): LOAD → INTEGRATE → PERSIST, the spec's own cross-run cycle at corpus scale. **"Direction mode" is not a third mode — it's the same root run with a sharper received goal** (a parameter).
- **Your downstream instinct splits in your favor twice.** YES — backward re-description and re-litigation of settled priors should never be routes (and already aren't: the spec's prescriptive-only identity excludes description). NO to the over-strong reading — **reflexive routes (TEST this verdict, REFINE this weak section) are forward work on the new artifact** and are precisely the challenge-SLOTS the gap finding wants present in every field; cutting them would re-open that under-coverage by rule. **"Downstream" = forward-looking engagements, onward AND reflexive** — implemented entirely by the goal phrase; no new rule.
- **Your fresh-focus claim and the fresh-eyes dial both stand — in different phases.** **Production vs consumption:** enumeration at source is bias-TOLERANT (routelisting never selects; the Excluded section forces rejected candidates to be visible with reasons; lean-to-split over-includes rather than hides) — so the warm post-critique session's maximum territory resolution is pure gain there; choosing remains governed by the dial (fresh eyes at consumption, unchanged). The one real bias surface — a warm session under-listing reflexive routes about its own verdict — is exactly what the stance nudge guards.
- **One correction critique enforced on this design's own enthusiasm:** the route-map is **the field's ENUMERATED CORE, not the whole field** — the turn's full field remains composite (route-map(s) ⊕ the ledger's parked areas ⊕ the Selector's control-options ⊕ any human supplements), per the gap finding's doctrine. The turn record's field-reference points at the route-map AND the ledger.
- **The canopy's honest scope:** within one expedition, the spine's growing context plus the leaves suffice — the canopy's irreplaceable work is **cross-inquiry identity merging at corpus/cross-session scale** (the same concept surfacing in five inquiries becomes ONE canopy identity). Integration cadence: at extended checkpoints (every 5th turn) and run-end — not per-turn. And the canopy starts as a **fresh corpus-scope index** — the existing `devdocs/routelister/_route.md` is goal-scoped to one trajectory (its own history records a conflated-goal deletion as a warning); no silent graduation.
- **The bootstrap does triple duty:** ONE root-run over the existing findings corpus births the corpus map (long missing), warms the shakedown Expedition's spine, and creates the canopy — three standing wants, one session.
- **Honest sizing on two baselines:** vs the designed architecture (your comparison — "over what we were designing"), ceremony is NET-NEGATIVE (the navigational session sheds N per-inquiry enumerations for one integrate-run); vs today's practice, it's a tiny added cost (~minutes per loop) buying the corpus's first CONSTANT field. A composition win — the spec's own cross-run machinery finally turned on at two scopes — **not** a new organ, and **not** the supplement-gap fix (collision/generation/rebinding stay organ-less; the composite field's third share is still you).

## Finding

*Context for a reader arriving fresh: routelister is the project's enumeration discipline — territory + goal in, typed route-field out, with a persistent concept-map index (`_route.md`) that successive runs load, update, and save. Until now nothing ran it routinely: the routelister-gap finding (earlier today) showed its modes going unrun between inquiries, while the planned navigational session was supposed to run it over finished work. The user proposed inverting that: each worker loop emits its own route-map at the end, and navigation becomes compilation.*

### 1. The verdict and its grounds

**ADOPT-REFINED**, on four grounds:

1. **Spec-legality by construction.** Routelister's identity is deliberately self-contained: the discipline never references larger processes, and *"how a caller uses its output is the caller's concern."* A runner invoking it post-CONCLUDE is caller composition — the one hazard (Process-coupling) lives only in wording the runner edit so that routelister's own spec stays silent about runners, which the proposed text does.
2. **The precedent (n=1).** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-03_15-39__task_define_discipline_meaning_layer/_route.md` is exactly this pattern run manually once: a per-inquiry index over a finding — 14 typed identities, conditional routes flagged — produced without spec strain.
3. **Habit→mechanism (the deepest ground).** The gap finding established that capabilities-unrun become gaps: within-territory tension-flags and depth-dives exist in the spec but "go unlisted because nobody runs those modes." Putting the run IN THE RUNNER converts an unrun mode into an automatic one — the general lesson being that capabilities survive by living in mechanisms, not practices.
4. **Spine value.** Every worker loop shipping its field as exhaust is what makes the Expedition's Mode B see-phase cheap (read + compile instead of generate) and the projectbase's route list CONSTANT — the user's words, mechanized.

**The redundancy objection, dissolved on epistemics:** the finding already carries Next Actions and Open Questions — but those are the AUTHOR's disposition-laden commitments (MUST/COULD are priority decisions) and typed gaps. The route-map is a different epistemic class: a TYPED, GOAL-RELATIVE, INDEX-ACCUMULATING field with no dispositions. The route run sweeps the finding's Next Actions and Open Questions as prime material and casts them as typed routes; the index machinery (which prose sections lack) is what enables corpus-scale integration.

### 2. The runner step (text-ready; a proposal for `/aMVLw` + `/MVLw`)

> **Post-CONCLUDE route step (runner-owned).** After CONCLUDE completes (status COMPLETE, summary printed):
> 1. Invoke `Skill(skill: "routelister", args: "[inquiry_path]/finding.md — Goal: advance from this finding toward [quote the finding's Goal line], including tests and refinements of this finding itself.")`
> 2. Routelister writes its two files per its own spec: `[inquiry_path]/routelister.md` + `[inquiry_path]/_route.md`.
> 3. **Non-blocking:** if the run fails, append one line to `_state.md` History and finish — the inquiry remains COMPLETE; the route-map can be produced later by re-running. (Missing route-maps are flagged by the next integrate-run — its fallback sweep notices leaf-less findings.)
> 4. Cold-session resumes run the step identically — the warmth bonus is absent, the mechanics the same.

Design decisions inside the text: **placement post-CONCLUDE** (pre-CONCLUDE would enumerate from discipline outputs about to be archived; post-CONCLUDE sweeps the distilled, self-contained artifact every consumer reads — and the session is still warm minutes later, so the fresh-focus claim survives); **territory = the finding only** (the archive is pre-distillation noise); **the goal is RECEIVED from the artifact** (goal-exogeneity honored mechanically — the cautionary precedent being the standalone index's own recorded deletion of a conflated-goal run); **`conclude.md` untouched** (the protocol is shared; the step is the runner's).

### 3. The navigational session's job: the integrate-run (your mode question)

**Root/breadth mode, index-extending, at corpus scope.** The per-inquiry maps and findings are its TERRITORY — **the leaves**; its own index is the **corpus-scope master `_route.md`** — **the canopy**: LOAD the canopy → INTEGRATE the fresh leaves (each swept item matches a canopy identity or starts a new one; non-re-confirmed entries get stale-flagged) → PERSIST. This is the spec's own cross-run cycle, just running at the scale above. **"Direction mode" = the same root run with a sharper received goal** — a parameter, not a third mode. Depth runs (concept-target mode) remain the drill option when one canopy identity needs its manifestations enumerated.

**The canopy's honest scope (critique's refinement):** within one expedition, the spine's growing context plus the leaves suffice — per-turn canopy consultation is unnecessary. The canopy's irreplaceable work is **cross-inquiry identity merging** beyond a single context window (five inquiries touching one concept become ONE canopy identity with five manifestations — what complement-perception needs at corpus scale and across sessions). **Integration cadence: extended checkpoints (every 5th turn) and run-end.**

**The canopy starts FRESH.** The existing `devdocs/routelister/_route.md` is goal-scoped ("the IE trajectory only") — and its own History records deleting a predecessor for goal-conflation. Silently graduating it to "the corpus" would repeat that mistake. The corpus canopy is a new index (proposed: `devdocs/routelister/_route_corpus.md`; name and home yours to set), created by the bootstrap with its goal explicitly corpus-scoped; the IE index stays what it is.

**The bootstrap (one session, triple duty):** a root-run over the existing findings corpus — births the corpus map (which has never existed), warms the shakedown Expedition's spine (the navigation warm-up it needs anyway), and creates the canopy the integrate-runs will extend. **Who runs integrate-runs today:** the human/assistant on demand (formalizing current manual practice); the Expedition's spine inherits it as its see-phase.

### 4. The two adjudications (your open questions)

**Downstream-only?** Split in your favor twice. Your instinct is RIGHT that backward-looking content doesn't belong: re-descriptions of how the territory works are already excluded by the spec's prescriptive-only identity, and re-litigation of settled priors would bloat maps with noise. But the over-strong reading — onward work only — would cut **reflexive routes** (TEST this finding's verdict; REFINE its weak section), which are forward work on the newest artifact AND the gap finding's challenge-SLOTS (the enumerable half of the most consequential move-class — your own dominant next-move). **Resolution: "downstream" = forward-looking engagements, onward and reflexive; implemented by the goal phrase** (*"…including tests and refinements of this finding itself"*) — no new rule needed.

**Fresh focus vs fresh eyes?** Both stand — **production vs consumption**. The per-inquiry run is PRODUCTION: enumeration is bias-tolerant by construction (enumerate-not-select — investment bias distorts picking, which this step never does; the Excluded section makes rejected candidates visible with reasons; lean-to-split over-includes rather than hides), and warmth is a production asset (maximum territory resolution, zero warm-up). The dial governs CONSUMPTION — whoever reads the field to CHOOSE still gets fresh eyes per the Turn Architecture, unchanged. The one real bias surface — a warm session under-listing tests of its own verdict — is the stance nudge's job, with the colder integrate-run as backstop.

### 5. Consequences — and the two honest boundaries

- **The Expedition:** the spine's see-phase becomes read+compile (intake per turn = finding + route-map + map delta); the see-phase's residual work = integrate + ledger-check + (your) supplements. The procedure note (already on the Expedition's build-list) gains one ingest line. No new build item — routelister exists.
- **Field-before-choice, served precisely:** the route-map is **the field's ENUMERATED CORE** — pre-written at source the moment a worker finishes. The turn's FULL field stays composite per the gap finding: route-map(s) ⊕ the ledger ⊕ control-options ⊕ supplements; the turn record's field-reference points at the route-map AND the ledger. (Critique caught this design's own overreach here — "the route-map IS the field" would have shrunk the field back to enumeration-only, the exact error corrected this morning.)
- **The gap finding's ledger:** the two usage-gaps CLOSE (tension-flags and depth-dive routes become runner-automatic); **the supplement gap stays OPEN** — no enumeration timing supplies collision, generation, or rebinding; the composite field's third share is still you.
- **Costs and reversal:** ~minutes per loop; the cheapest rollback in the corpus (delete one runner step); map-noise-at-scale is the named unknown, mitigated by the spec's own machinery (identities-not-manifestations; stale-flagging; goal-bias) and observable as leaves accumulate.
- **The analogy (one):** CI artifacts — every build emits its reports as exhaust; dashboards aggregate; the build never decides what to build next. The loop emits; the canopy aggregates; choosing stays the Selector's.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** routelister's spec — self-containment + the Process-coupling guard; the two-file contract; scoped indices per territory+goal; the cross-run LOAD-INTEGRATE-PERSIST cycle; goal-exogeneity; enumerate-not-select.
  - **Source:** `cognitive_harness/routelister/SKILL.md` + `references/routelister.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, USED-AS-DESIGNED. **Evidence:** every mechanism the composition needs is the spec's own (scoped indices make per-inquiry files conformant; the canopy run IS the integrate cycle at corpus scale); the discipline's text is untouched; the one hazard (Process-coupling) is averted by keeping the step runner-owned; the two-file contract killed the drop-the-index variant.

- **Commitment:** the routelister-gap finding — the composite field; the four hard-miss kinds; the two usage-gaps; the supplement gap open.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_16-09__routelister_capability_gap_route_kinds_missed/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed and DEFENDED. **Evidence:** the composition operationalizes the usage-gap rows (the unrun modes become automatic) without touching the hard-miss conclusions; critique actively protected the composite-field doctrine from this design's own field-artifact overreach (the enumerated-core correction); the stance nudge exists BECAUSE of the gap finding's challenge-slot analysis.

- **Commitment:** the Turn Architecture — field-before-choice; the see-phase as discipline-with-dial; goal-formation as the human's seat.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_14-00__metaloop_orchestrator_role_architecture_from_scratch/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, frame sharpened. **Evidence:** the dial resolves to CONSUMPTION (choosing) while this step is PRODUCTION (enumeration) — both the user's fresh-focus claim and the dial's fresh-eyes rationale stand in their phases; the validity condition gains its concrete artifact (the route-map as the field's enumerated core, with the ledger alongside); goals stay received (the finding supplies them).

- **Commitment:** the Expedition — Mode B spine intake; the see-phase; the build-list; the supervised mode.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_14-41__lone_traversal_loop_operational_breakthrough/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, EXTENDED. **Evidence:** the spine's see-phase becomes read+compile with intake = finding + route-map + delta; the build-list gains NO new item (one line in the already-planned procedure note); the bootstrap doubles as the shakedown's spine warm-up; the canopy's cadence maps onto the existing extended-checkpoint rhythm.

Pattern-note: all four confirmed — one used-as-designed, one defended against this very design's enthusiasm, two extended. The inquiry's sharpest refinements came from protecting its own priors (the enumerated-core correction; the fresh-canopy decision against silent goal-graduation).

## Next Actions

### MUST

None — the composition is adopted as design; its edits are proposals awaiting your approval.

### COULD

- **What:** Apply the **runner-step edit** (the boxed text in section 2) to `cognitive_harness/aMVLw/SKILL.md` + `cognitive_harness/MVLw/SKILL.md`.
  **Who:** one short edit session (assistant executes on your word).
  **Gate:** observable — your approval.
  **Why:** habit→mechanism; every loop starts emitting its field.

- **What:** Run the **bootstrap** — one root-mode routelister run over the existing findings corpus, creating the fresh corpus-scope canopy index.
  **Who:** one session.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — any time; highest leverage BEFORE the shakedown Expedition (it doubles as the spine's warm-up).
  **Why:** triple duty — the corpus map's birth + spine warming + the canopy.

- **What:** Add the **ingest line** (spine reads `routelister.md` alongside the finding) to the Expedition procedure note when that note is written.
  **Who:** rides the Expedition's existing build-list item.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — the note's drafting.
  **Why:** the see-phase wiring.
  **Depends-on:** the Expedition finding's MUST "the one-page expedition procedure note". GATED — the line rides that note.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** Extending the step to `/MVL` (classic) and `/MVL+`.
  **Gate:** revival trigger — your call, any time (the step text is runner-portable).
  **Why (if revived):** uniform exhaust across all loop variants.

- **What:** The supplement organ (unchanged from the gap finding's seed — organ/reposition vs centaur, decided by the retrospective tally).
  **Gate:** unchanged — the tally.
  **Why (if revived):** the composite field's third share; this composition is already organ-ready (new route kinds would join the same maps).

## Reasoning

**Why ADOPT rather than redesign.** The proposal needed no rescue — the spec was built for exactly this load-modify-save composition (scoped indices; the integrate cycle), and the strongest counter (redundancy with Next Actions) dissolved on an epistemic distinction (dispositions vs typed indexed field) rather than a patch. The refinements are placements and phrasings, not repairs.

**Why the user's own phrasings kept winning.** "Running routelister in root mode" — exactly the integrate-run; the downstream instinct — right about backward noise; "constant route list in the projectbase" — the exhaust framing mechanized. Where his guesses needed refining (reflexive routes; the canopy's necessity), the refinement came with the mechanism (the challenge-slots; cross-context identity merging), not with deference or dismissal.

**Significant kills and self-corrections.** *The field-artifact overreach* — this design's own most quotable line ("the route-map IS the field") was cut by critique for contradicting the composite-field doctrine minted the same day; the enumerated-core phrasing keeps both. *The silent index graduation* — the existing IE-scoped `_route.md`'s own deletion-history was cited against quietly making it "the corpus"; the canopy starts fresh. *The ceremony arithmetic* — "net-negative" forced onto two honest baselines. *Dropping the per-inquiry index* — killed by the spec's own two-file contract. *The stance-nudge removal* — killed: the one bias guard, free to keep. *Forestry and library analogies* — killed by the analogy budget (CI seated).

**Self-reference handling.** Mild but present (the system adopting its own exhaust design): every mechanism cites spec text or an inspected artifact; the one bias surface (warm sessions under-listing self-tests) is named against the design and guarded; and the three special-attention items all resolved by making the design MORE modest (enumerated core; cadence-scoped canopy; detector-backed tolerance).

## Open Questions

### Monitoring

- **Per-inquiry map quality** — observable: the first 3–5 automatic route-maps (do they match the n=1 precedent's richness? do reflexive routes appear, vindicating the stance nudge?).
- **Map-noise at scale** — observable: the canopy's identity count and stale-flag rate as leaves accumulate (~20+ inquiries).
- **The detector working** — observable: the first integrate-run's leaf-less-findings flag (should name exactly the pre-adoption findings).

### Blocked

- **The canopy's read-pattern by an autonomous Selector** — blocked on the Selector's L2 graduation (until then, you are its reader).

### Refinement Triggers

- **If per-inquiry maps run shallow** (visibly thinner than the precedent): the goal-phrase template revises first (cheapest lever) before any placement rethink.
- **If the canopy bloats despite stale-flagging:** the integrate-run's goal sharpens (the "direction mode" parameter exists for exactly this).
- **If the supplement organ is built:** its route kinds join the same per-inquiry maps — re-read section 5's organ-ready note; no rework expected.

## Source Input

<details>
<summary>Raw user input for this finding</summary>

```text
why not after each query we are not running routelister with respecet to that inquiry outputs? it ll generate route md file and routelister.md file 

and this way navigational session can be just about compiling  routelister.md  route md into bigger more directional map , 

i think this is one significant design improvement over what we were designing. it simplifies things a lot , nagivational session becomes something more focus on general direction since it is not running routelister for each inquiry but it is reading them and running  routelister in root mode? or in direction mode?

this might be a small size breakthrough even. bc adding one more routelisting to the end of MVLw loop is gonna produce constant route list in the projectbase.  and these routelists since they ll run jsut after critique , they will be using the fresh focus on that subject and generate more accurate downstream routes

i guess they should only generate downstream routes . this can be a good next frontier to dive deep into.  i am not so sure about thsi.
```

---
status: active
model: claude-fable-5[1m]
effort: max
impacted_by: devdocs/inquiries/2026-06-10_18-50__deferred_vs_gated_route_state_vocabulary/finding.md
