# Finding: Views Are the Read-Path Compaction Layer — Your Proposal, Adjudicated Better-as-Amended

## Changes from Prior

**Prior path:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_09-13__generate_concept_view_protocol/finding.md`
**Revision trigger:** the user's proposal — views' purpose re-grounded as read-reduction for whole-project (non-worker) warm-ups, with stabilized-concepts-only selection and the reading formula "all views + non-view findings" — and their doubt (entanglement; info-loss; "is this better?").
**What's preserved:** the protocol's whole design (modes, constitution, mechanism, ceremony, trail).
**What's new:** the PURPOSE STATEMENT the design was missing (read-path compaction, with measured numbers); the coverage definitions (edge-coverage; the frontier); the three-tier read doctrine (digest-read / full-read / topic-read) with the full-read recipe; the guards (staleness-visible; the frontier-count metric; the airtight valve).
**Migration:** none — the doctrine lines (~25) join the protocol's build (the fourth enrichment of the same build route).

## Question

From `_branch.md`: *"I'm still not sure how views contribute to traversal memory — not all concepts can feasibly become views; concepts entangle, borders aren't clean; view-compression might lose information and lead us wrong. My idea: navigational (non-worker) sessions need whole-project awareness, but full reads are infeasible even skipping superseded. So: generate views only for already-STABILIZED concepts; the point is reducing total finding.md reads; a navigational session reads all views + the non-view findings. Do you think this is better?"*

## Finding Summary

- **Yes — better, and most of it was already ours.** Your selection rule (views only for stabilized concepts) is exactly what the stabilization ceremony selects; your "point" — total raw reads going down — is the purpose statement the design was missing. Verdict: **better-as-amended**, and the main amendment saves your own objection.

- **The correction that saves your entanglement objection:** you're right that concepts entangle and borders aren't clean — which kills ANY coverage rule phrased at the concept level, including your own "non-view findings." The fix keeps your idea and drops the broken unit: **coverage is decided per FINDING, on edges that are clean by construction** — a finding leaves the raw-read set when something supersedes or consolidates it (its refiner's frontmatter says so, borderlessly). No concept borders needed anywhere.

- **The purpose statement, plainly:** the corpus grows forever (history is sacred) and a session's window doesn't. So the corpus splits into two read-layers: **the frontier** (live findings nothing has consolidated — read RAW at summary grade) and **the compacted past** (read through views). Stabilization ceremonies move material from the first to the second: one consolidation supersedes N priors, and N raw reads become one view-head. **Views + ceremonies are traversal memory's read-path compaction layer — the mechanism that keeps whole-project awareness affordable as the corpus grows.** (Honesty note: read-path compaction only — storage never deletes.)

- **The numbers, labeled honestly (critique un-laundered them):** the raw whole-project read is **~34,000 lines** (your infeasibility premise, verified — even skipping superseded). **Today — with zero views existing — the summary-grade frontier read is ~2,640 lines** (120 frontier findings × ~22-line summaries): feasible RIGHT NOW. **At ~5-view maturity: ~3,500 lines projected**, shrinking as ceremonies consolidate. About a 10× reduction against raw, and it fits a window.

- **The frontier is computable today, no registry:** live findings (166) minus supersession targets (46, basename-matched) = **frontier: 120**. Two greps. That count becomes the health metric, printed in the digest's header.

- **The three read-tiers, named by what they read** (not by session-type — no session taxonomy exists): **digest-read** (default light warm-up, 204 lines) · **full-read** (your non-worker case: all views → compute the remainder → summary-read it; ~2.6k today) · **topic-read** (working a concept: its view + drilled findings, unchanged).

- **Your info-loss worry gets a structural answer, not a promise:** the newest, decision-heaviest material — everything not yet consolidated — is **never read through a view at all**; it stays raw (the frontier). And on any conflict, **the raw frontier outranks any view** (subordination applied to warm-up). Only the already-judged past is ever compressed.

- **The race, honestly:** the full-read stays cheap only while consolidations keep rough pace with new inquiries — otherwise the frontier bloats back toward infeasibility (gracefully: linear, not cliff). The frontier count makes the race visible. **And the valve is airtight:** ceremonies stay yours to declare; sessions never self-initiate ceremonies or view-generation off the metric; the number is for your eyes.

- **Zero new maintained artifacts** — views regenerate on demand; coverage derives from existing frontmatter; the count derives from greps. Your "another mess" worry has no artifact to live in.

## Finding

### 1. The verdict, with the credit and the correction

Your proposal contributes three things. Two are adopted whole: the **purpose** (the point of views is read-economics — the design had the mechanism but never stated what it buys traversal memory) and the **reading formula** (a warm-up tier that reads the compressed layer plus the raw remainder — genuinely new doctrine). The third — your selection rule, stabilized-concepts-only — was already the shipped ceremony's selection, which is confirmation from two directions. One thing needed correcting, and your own argument does the correcting: concepts entangle (~8–10 per finding, measured), so "non-view finding" is undecidable at the concept level — but supersession edges have clean borders by construction (`refines:`/`supersedes:`/`corrects:` frontmatter either names a finding or doesn't). Coverage moves to the finding level, and your entanglement objection stops being a problem and becomes the reason the design is shaped this way.

### 2. The purpose, built up from the need

A growing corpus and a bounded window force a split. What should be read raw? The material whose judgment is still open — the frontier. What can be read compressed? The material history has already judged — superseded and consolidated findings, whose content lives downstream by explicit edge. The ceremony is the pump between the layers: each full-tier consolidation supersedes N priors, removing N files from every future raw read and adding one consolidation (whose summary heads the regenerated view). Run the numbers on today's corpus: raw read ≈ 34,000 lines (infeasible — your premise held); the frontier at summary grade ≈ 2,640 lines (feasible now, zero views needed); at maturity with ~5 stabilized-concept views ≈ 3,500 lines, and FALLING as ceremonies shrink the frontier faster than views grow. That is what views contribute to traversal memory: **without them (and the ceremonies behind them), whole-project awareness dies by arithmetic; with them, it costs a tenth and stays bounded.**

### 3. The coverage mechanics (build-ready)

1. **Edge-covered:** the finding is a supersession/consolidation target — its content lives downstream; safe to meet as one line anywhere. *(46 live today.)* **The honest clause (critique's material catch):** the corpus's edges are overwhelmingly `refines:` (135 refines / 8 supersedes / 32 corrects), and a refined prior's commitments may STILL BIND — edge-coverage is therefore **awareness-grade**, and it rides the re-test mandate: every refiner must carry its prior's commitments (re-tested or explicitly inherited), so reading the chain's newest link reads a document that declares what it preserved. Where a refiner skipped its re-test, the compression over-trusts — one more reason the mandate is load-bearing. Binding-grade reading (a worker needing the prior's full constraints) drills the chain: topic-read territory.
2. **The frontier:** live findings that are not edge-covered — *frontier = live finding.md paths minus the corpus's frontmatter targets, matched by basename* (the era-bulk rider's lesson applies here too). **120 today, by two greps.**
3. *(Soft-coverage demoted:)* a finding already met as a top-k excerpt in step 1's views is skipped in step 3 — a **dedup clause**, not a load-bearing concept (the excerpt ≈ the summary; the saving is only the duplicate).

### 4. The read doctrine (build-ready)

**Tiers are named by what they read:**

- **digest-read** — the default light warm-up: the project digest (204 lines, recency-shaped).
- **full-read** — whole-project awareness (your non-worker case):
  1. **Read all views** (note each header's date; collect top-k excerpt source paths as you go).
  2. **Compute the remainder:** the frontier (two basename-matched greps) minus the paths collected in step 1.
  3. **Summary-read the remainder** (the Finding-Summary regex per file).
  **Rule: on any conflict, the raw frontier summary outranks any view.** The step-2 count prints with the read.
- **topic-read** — working a concept: its view + drilled findings (on-demand, unchanged).

### 5. The guards

- **Staleness (safe-by-construction, made visible):** views may be stale between regenerations — by design. The warm-up survives it because whatever moved past a view arrives RAW in the same read (the frontier includes everything newer, including precisely the findings that made the view stale); frontier-wins orders any conflict; every view prints its date. Regenerating first is always available, never required.
- **The race (the honest operating condition):** the full-read stays cheap only while ceremonies keep rough pace with inquiries; degradation is graceful (linear in the frontier count). **The frontier count prints in the digest's header** (`frontier: 120`) — the health metric, derived per run, no bookkeeping.
- **The valve (airtight):** ceremonies remain user-declared (the fuzziness boundary untouched); the warm-up reads only the views that EXIST (nothing generates at warm-up); **sessions never self-initiate ceremonies or view-generation off the metric** — a heavy frontier is reported as a number, never converted into pressure.

### 6. One house principle this surfaced

The frontier-stays-raw rule mirrors the seeds-trail-free rule from the trail inquiry: in both, the newest layer is read unmediated and compression only ever applies to what history has already judged. One line worth keeping: **the newest layer is never mediated.**

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

The `_branch.md` declared a Synthesis Trigger over three priors. Re-tests ran at critique; inherited with evidence:

- **Commitment:** freedom-first timing + the fuzziness boundary (from the lifecycle doctrine).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_09-55__view_timing_stabilization_and_archive_question/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed, with the valve HARDENED. **Evidence:** the read-economics purpose was prosecuted as gate-creep's cousin ("must stabilize to keep warm-up cheap"); the valve now closes every pressure path including the subtle one — sessions never self-initiate ceremonies off the metric; the number is information for the user, never a push. Nothing gates on stabilization; the full-read reads whatever exists.

- **Commitment:** one-concept-per-view (from the lifecycle doctrine).
  - **Source:** same finding.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — commitment confirmed; the multiple-coverage cost measured as bounded. **Evidence:** a finding excerpted top-k in several views is read once per view (~25 lines each); plausible worst at maturity ≈ +250–500 lines — inside the projection's stated range, and the dedup clause names it.

- **Commitment:** the protocol's size/cost claims + the closed-trail economics.
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_09-13__generate_concept_view_protocol/finding.md` + `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_10-22__superseded_material_in_views_purpose/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — confirmed with one un-laundering. **Evidence:** the warm-up arithmetic was recomputed at the letter and the "~3.5k today" claim caught as a PROJECTION (today, with zero views, the honest number is ~2,640 — pure frontier); the finding presents three labeled numbers (raw 34k / today 2.6k / maturity ~3.5k). The 10× reduction claim stands against the raw baseline.

## Next Actions

### MUST

*(None — the adjudication is the deliverable; the doctrine lands with the build, gated on your word.)*

### COULD

- **What:** the protocol build, fourth enrichment — the read doctrine's ~25 lines join the transcription (tiers · the 3-step recipe with frontier-wins · the coverage definitions with the awareness-grade clause · the metric line · the valve · the purpose paragraph with three labeled numbers).
  **Who:** the AI, within the same ≤30-minute build.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your word (`[∥]` the protocol map's build route, now carrying four inquiries' lines).
  **Why:** the protocol ships as the complete read-side of traversal memory.

- **What:** the full-read's first run — validate the 2.6k today-number live (zero views → pure frontier at summary grade; print the count; record where the recipe chafes).
  **Who:** the AI, after the build.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — after the build.
  **Why:** a warm-up doctrine that has never warmed anything is paper.
  **Depends-on:** the build. GATED.

- **What:** the re-test-mandate audit — sample the 135 refiners by era for `Inherited Commitments Re-test` coverage; where old chains lack re-tests, edge-coverage over-trusts (implication: a caution line or back-fill consolidations — unknown until measured).
  **Who:** the AI, cheap sampling.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — before trusting old chains in full-reads (or at your curiosity).
  **Why:** critique showed the mandate is load-bearing for compression safety; honesty extends to measuring what it rides.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** the all-views cap (when the view count makes "read all views" heavy).
  **Gate:** condition-bound — the tier's own printed arithmetic saying so.
  **Why (if revived):** relevance-filtered view selection; a scale problem for a scale that doesn't exist yet.

## Reasoning

**Why better-as-amended rather than plain yes:** your formula's load-bearing term ("non-view findings") was undefined, and the only definition that survives your own entanglement argument is the finding-level one — adopting the proposal unamended would have shipped the broken unit. **Why finding-level coverage is safe to that amendment:** supersession edges are explicit, borderless, and carried forward by the re-test mandate — with the honest bound stated (awareness-grade; 135 of the corpus's 175 edges are refines, where priors may still bind; the refiner's carrying duty is what makes the compression safe, and its coverage is now a routed audit).

**Significant kills:** concept-level coverage (the user's own argument); "navigational session" as tier-vocabulary (undefined session taxonomy — tiers renamed by what they read); the 6-step recipe (compressed to 3); soft-coverage as a load-bearing concept (demoted to a dedup clause — the excerpt ≈ the summary); the projection-as-measurement (un-laundered into three labeled numbers); mandatory freshness gates (staleness is visible instead); any new registry or state file (everything derives per run).

## Open Questions

### Monitoring
- The full-read's first run: does the 2.6k estimate hold, and where does the recipe chafe?
- Does the frontier count in the digest header actually get looked at (the memory-iff-read test, on the metric)?

### Blocked
- Everything landing — blocked on the protocol build (your word), by design.

### Refinement Triggers
- If the re-test-mandate audit finds thin coverage on old chains → add the old-chain caution line to the full-read, or route back-fill consolidations (your call — the valve applies to back-fills too).
- If the frontier count trends up across several digests → the race is being lost; the number is on your desk, the ceremonies are yours to declare.

## Source Input

<summary>Raw user input for this finding</summary>

```text
i am still not so sure how creating and maintaining the views will contribute to traversal memory, for generic understanding yes maybe, but all concepts cant be feasibly generete into views, concepts overlap and entangle and borders are not so clean.

So this view approach might get us into another mess, with informatin loss due to view it might even lead us wrong way.

we should be smart about how we design this.  i think generic idea is this.

non worker session , lets say navigational session should have whole project as a view. but it is not feasible to read all inquiries for each new session as a warm up.  even if we skip superseeded ones ,

so what we can do is to select certain topics and concepts, and generate view for them, these are already stabilized concepts,

and the point is to reduce the number of total finding.md reads via this compressed views of stabilized concepts.

and non worker session, still reads all views and non view findings

do you think this is better?
```

</details>

---
status: active

# Finding: The Isolated Session Was Never Asked to Carry It All — Feasibility for the Share, with the Direction Layer Fixed

## Changes from Prior

**Prior path:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_11-00__views_as_read_reduction_for_navigational_sessions/finding.md`
**Revision trigger:** the user's feasibility probe — can an isolated session, warm-started from views, carry holistic understanding (where-going + where-was) AND spontaneous attention to past details, with all responsibility on its own context?
**What's preserved:** the read doctrine (tiers, coverage, guards) and all upstream commitments.
**What's new:** the responsibility answer (canon-grounded); THE GAP FOUND AND FIXED — no tier read the direction layer (step 0 added); the order line; the digest's direction pointer; the honest post-step-0 numbers; the spontaneity mechanism split (session-salience vs consciousness-layer attention).
**Migration:** none — four doctrine additions join the protocol's build (the fifth enrichment of the same route).

## Question

From `_branch.md`: *"Assume we have these view-like things to shorten the history load. How will that help an isolated session using them? We need holistic understanding — where the project is going and where it was. And we need spontaneous attention to past details, because something new can be relevant to something old. But all responsibility will be with the isolated AI session's context? How feasible is this?"*

## Finding Summary

- **Your premise contradicts the architecture's own design — in a reassuring direction.** The north star assigns the roles explicitly: the SYSTEM handles subconscious work (disciplines, runners, artifacts); **the HUMAN is the consciousness layer — spontaneous attention, valuation, cross-inquiry memory, goal-formation — at Level 0, by canon.** The session's context was never asked to carry it all; it is one memory-organ of seven (summaries · pointers+chains · route-maps · `_state.md` · read-surfaces · protocols · the human).

- **The organs work by staged loading, not from disk** — in-context-only is physics, conceded: the warm-up stages the first load; the programs FORCE the rest (surfacing's sweep is a mandatory /traverse step; the Synthesis Trigger derives mechanically; CONCLUDE refuses to close without inheritance accounting). **One residue the steelman earned: protection is one-invocation-deep.** A session started with no runner and no warm-up gets none of this. Responsibility concentrates into the first line typed — the design's shape, not its flaw: everything after that line is spec-forced, and the line is genuinely load-bearing.

- **This inquiry broke the holistic claim as shipped, and fixed it:** the full-read read views + frontier — where-it-WAS only. Nothing read the direction layer (canon: 3,391 lines; the route-map field: 26 live maps, 2,370 lines — measured, absent from every tier). **The fix is step 0:** read the direction documents (role-first, instances named — today `project_north_star.md` + `sustained_traversal_loop_of_loops.md`), then scan recent maps' open routes (format-contract: the ✓ column empty = open; the grep ships TESTED at build). ~600 lines.

- **The honest numbers, post-fix:** full-read today ≈ **3.2k lines** (direction + pure frontier; zero views yet); at ~5-view maturity ≈ **3.6–3.9k** — still about a tenth of the 34k raw read. **The order line:** direction first, views middle, frontier last — the live edge sits where attention is freshest; the settled past (the most redundant layer) absorbs the middle. And the digest header gains a one-line direction pointer, so even light sessions know where steering lives.

- **"Spontaneous attention" names two different things — the answer must not blur them.** The STANDING kind (an unprompted cross-session watcher) is the consciousness-layer capability: **yours today, by canon's own assignment** ("nothing watches between inquiries yet — precisely what SUSTRALL's traversal memory changes"). What the session has is weaker and real: **within-window salience** — every token loaded at warm-up is attended at every forward pass, so a frontier summary can light up mid-work, unasked. Honestly bounded: it degrades with length and position (a known long-context effect, not measured locally), and covers only what was loaded. This is the same mechanism the closed trail rides — in-window presence keeps evidence attendable; there for killing revived claims, here for lighting up old details.

- **Beyond the window, recall is deliberate and FORCED:** every inquiry's surfacing step re-greps the territory fresh; the Synthesis Trigger names the priors; the supersession walk re-tags the moved. The session doesn't remember the project — it re-derives the relevant slice per question, from artifacts built to make re-derivation cheap.

- **The verdict: FEASIBLE — for the session's share, which is the share the architecture actually assigns.** With step 0, a cold full-read session holds the objective, the open field, the settled story, and the raw live edge in ~3.2k lines, with every deeper need one pointer away and the programs forcing the reads. **Two limits, stated without flinching:** (1) standing cross-session noticing is the human's today — and the verdict is the current rung, not the ceiling: growing the system's share of the watching is what the SUSTRALL program is FOR; (2) free-form sessions (no runner, no warm-up) are exactly as blind as your worry fears — one right invocation away from working, one lazy one from inert.

## Finding

### 1. Where memory-responsibility actually lives

Start from what canon already commits. The north star's delegation map is explicit: the system owns the SUBCONSCIOUS work — structured thinking (the disciplines), pattern-following composition (the runners), durable artifacts (the inquiry folders) — while the human is the CONSCIOUSNESS layer: spontaneous attention, valuation, real-time steering, cross-inquiry memory, goal-formation. That is not an aspiration; it is the Level-0 architecture, and the between-inquiries gap is named in the same document as SUSTRALL's target. So the question "can the session's context carry it all?" has a design answer before any mechanism is examined: it was never asked to. Around the context sit six other organs — scent-bearing summaries, pointers and supersession chains, the route-maps, `_state.md`, the read-surfaces, the protocols — and the seventh is you.

The steelman deserves its full run here: *only in-context tokens influence the next token; organs on disk are potential energy; a lazy session reads nothing and the system is inert.* All true — and it is exactly why the design's whole effort goes into **staged loading**: the warm-up doctrine stages the first load, and the programs force every later one (surfacing's territory sweep is a mandatory step of /traverse, not a suggestion; the Synthesis Trigger derives mechanically from the articulation; CONCLUDE's template refuses a finding without the inheritance re-test). Nothing works from disk; everything works by getting loaded on schedule. What survives of the steelman is one honest residue: **all of this is one-invocation-deep.** A session nobody pointed at a runner or a warm-up gets none of it. That is the design's shape seen from its exposed side — a human-energized system SHOULD concentrate its required discipline into one typed line — and the line is genuinely load-bearing.

### 2. Holistic understanding — the gap this inquiry found and fixed

Holistic decomposes into where-it-WAS and where-it-GOING, and checking the shipped tiers at the letter found a real hole: the full-read read views + frontier — the settled story and the live edge — while the DIRECTION layer sat unread in every tier. It existed all along: the canon documents state the objective; the route-maps hold the open field (26 live maps, 2,370 lines of typed onward routes). The fix, sized honestly:

> **Step 0 (the direction layer):** read the direction documents — the canon that states the objective and the loop-of-loops direction (today: `project_north_star.md` + `sustained_traversal_loop_of_loops.md`; if canon reorganizes, the direction role is whatever states objective + direction). Then scan the digest-window maps' open routes (format-contract: open = an At-a-glance row whose ✓ column — the last — is empty; the exact grep ships tested at build).

~600 lines. The full-read becomes: **direction → views → frontier**, with the order line earning its place against a known long-context effect: *direction first, views middle, frontier last — the live edge sits where attention is freshest; the settled past, the most redundant layer (tagged, pointed, regenerable), absorbs the middle.* Numbers, un-laundered: today ≈ 3.2k (zero views exist; direction + pure frontier); at ~5-view maturity ≈ 3.6–3.9k. And one line for the light tier: the digest header — already carrying `frontier: N` — gains `direction: docs/canon/project_north_star.md`, so even a digest-only session knows where steering lives.

### 3. Spontaneous attention — the split, then the shares

The phrase names two capabilities. The STANDING kind — a watcher that notices, unprompted, across sessions, that today's work touches an old constraint — is the consciousness-layer capability, and canon assigns it to the human at Level 0. What an isolated session has is weaker and real: **within-window salience.** Everything the warm-up loaded is attended at every forward pass — that is how transformers work — so a loaded frontier summary can light up mid-task without being asked. Honest bounds: the effect degrades with context length and position (a known long-context effect, not measured locally), and it covers only the loaded surface. This is the same mechanism the closed trail rides — in-window presence keeps evidence attendable — one fact serving two consumers: there, the critique step's ability to kill revived dead claims; here, the worker's chance of noticing an old detail.

Beyond the window, recall is deliberate, and the design does not leave "deliberate" to mood: every inquiry's surfacing step re-greps the territory fresh (recall re-derived per question); the Synthesis Trigger forces the named priors into context; the supersession walk re-tags what moved. The session never REMEMBERS the project; it re-derives the relevant slice, on schedule, from artifacts built to make re-derivation cheap — which is what the summaries, pointers, and chains are for.

### 4. The verdict

**Feasible — for the session's share.** With step 0 in place, a cold full-read session holds the objective and open field, the settled story, and the raw live edge in ~3.2k lines; everything deeper is one pointer away, and the programs force the reads at the right moments. The two limits, plainly: standing cross-session noticing remains the human's — by canon's assignment, not by this design's failure — **and the verdict is the current rung, not the ceiling: growing the system's share of the watching is what the SUSTRALL program (traversal memory; the navigation-session role, already canon-defined with its question-list) is for.** And protection is one-invocation-deep: free-form sessions get none of it. The system is one right invocation away from working — and one lazy invocation away from inert.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

The `_branch.md` declared a Synthesis Trigger over three priors. Re-tests ran at critique; inherited with evidence:

- **Commitment:** the three-tier read doctrine + its numbers (from the read-reduction finding).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_11-00__views_as_read_reduction_for_navigational_sessions/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — **confirmed but INCOMPLETE as shipped; completed here.** **Evidence:** the where-going check failed at the letter (no tier read canon or route-maps — measured); step 0 closes it; the tier's own arithmetic was re-broken by the addition (the maturity projection rose past its stated range) and corrected to 3.6–3.9k. The doctrine's claims now match its reads.

- **Commitment:** the closed trail's evidence-availability rationale (from the superseded-material finding).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_10-22__superseded_material_in_views_purpose/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — confirmed and UNIFIED. **Evidence:** the trail's rationale and this inquiry's spontaneity mechanism are one fact (in-window presence keeps material attendable), stated once with both consumers named — no divergence into seeming-two-mechanisms.

- **Commitment:** the externalization thesis (canon: the mind lives in loop-structure + artifacts).
  - **Source:** `docs/canon/project_north_star.md` + `docs/canon/sustained_traversal_loop_of_loops.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — confirmed WITH the physics conceded. **Evidence:** the thesis discharges the all-on-context premise only through staged loading (organs work by getting loaded; spec-forcing guarantees the schedule inside runners); the steelman's true core (in-context-only) is kept in the mechanism's own wording, and its residue (one-invocation-deep) is carried as doctrine, not defeated.

## Next Actions

### MUST

*(None — the adjudication is the deliverable; the additions land with the build, gated on your word.)*

### COULD

- **What:** the protocol build, fifth enrichment — step 0 (role-first, instances named) + the order line + the digest's direction pointer + the open-route format-contract (grep tested at build) + the honest numbers.
  **Who:** the AI, within the same ≤30-minute build.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your word (`[∥]` the protocol map's build route, now carrying five inquiries' lines).
  **Why:** the full-read ships actually holistic — objective, open field, settled story, live edge.

- **What:** the first COLD navigation-session run — after the build: a fresh session, only the full-read instruction; warm up; then ask it the canon role's own question-list (which findings recent/corrected; which branches open; which directions wasted); grade what it holds, misses, and where the warm-up chafes.
  **Who:** you start it (the one load-bearing invocation); the AI runs.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — after the build.
  **Why:** this inquiry answered feasibility from architecture and arithmetic; honesty completes when a real cold session runs the role.
  **Depends-on:** the build. GATED.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** growing the system's share of the standing watch (SUSTRALL's traversal memory; the write-half).
  **Gate:** the roadmap's own program (`[∥ 18-48 R1/R2; 00-53 R1]`).
  **Why (if revived):** the ladder's next rung — the verdict here is the current one.

## Reasoning

**Why the premise-dissolution is the answer's spine:** the user asked "how feasible is X?" where X (context carries everything) is a design nobody built; answering X directly would grade a strawman. The honest move was relocating the question to the design that exists (the share), conceding what the steelman proved about it (one-invocation-deep), and fixing the one real gap the check found (direction).

**Why the gap-find matters beyond this question:** the full-read was designed one inquiry ago and already audited false on its own "holistic" claim — the where-going check is exactly the kind of letter-level verification this house's method exists for; the fix cost ~600 lines and one header pointer.

**Significant kills:** grading the strawman (context-carries-all); organs-work-from-disk phrasing (physics conceded instead); filename-hardcoded step 0 (role-first with instances); an untested open-route grep (format-contract + test-at-build — the regex lesson, third application); the unlabeled lost-in-the-middle claim (known-effect label); permanent-human-dependence readings (the ladder explicit).

## Open Questions

### Monitoring
- The first cold run (R2): what does a real cold session hold, miss, and chafe on?
- Does the digest's direction pointer get followed when steering questions arise in light sessions?

### Blocked
- Everything landing — blocked on the protocol build (your word), by design.

### Refinement Triggers
- If the cold run's misses trace to summary quality → the summary-quality practice becomes a route (it is load-bearing for three mechanisms now: discovery, the trail, and salience).
- If lost-in-the-middle visibly bites at 3–4k warm-ups → revisit the order line's sufficiency (e.g., a closing recap of direction at the warm-up's end — recency for the objective too).

but all responsibility will be with context of the isolated AI session? how feasible this is?

# Finding: The Use-Side Paradigm Map — Eleven Ways the Past Reaches the Present

## Changes from Prior

**Prior path:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_13-10__isolated_session_feasibility_holistic_and_spontaneous/finding.md`
**Revision trigger:** the user's ask — the paradigm list for the traversal-memory USER (the consumption side; the creation side already has its 8-family sweep).
**What's preserved:** everything — this finding ADDS the complement map and places the shipped design on it; nothing upstream is revised.
**What's new:** the 11-family use-side map in 6 delivery-mode clusters; the composite placement; the four empty seats; one exclusion; two labeled cross-map imports (F3's and F5's read-halves).
**Migration:** none — the list is the deliverable; a persisted sweeper-grade map is routed on your word.

## Question

From `_branch.md`: *"Can you generate, as a list, what other paradigms exist for the traversal-memory user?"* — the USE side: how a session (or you) warms up, recalls, and gets steered by the past.

## Finding Summary

- **The map in one sentence *(a partition, not a ranking)*: the past reaches the present six ways — you READ it, you PULL it, it SITS WITH you, it COMES TO you, ANOTHER MIND holds it, or you REBUILD it.** Eleven families across those six clusters.

- **The current design is a COMPOSITE, not a point** — it occupies six-plus seats at once (compressed-surface + query-driven + index-first + standing-surface + you-as-oracle + reconstructive-as-doctrine). Judging "the current paradigm" against alternatives is a category error; the real questions are per-seat.

- **The most valuable empty seat is canon-admitted: PUSH-DRIVEN** — nothing watches between inquiries yet; a watcher that interrupts when new work touches old constraints is SUSTRALL's designed occupant. The other empty seats: **prefetch** (task-predicted warm-ups), the **session-oracle** (canon's navigation-session role, unbuilt), and **authored tours** (real onboarding curricula).

- **Two families are read-halves of creation-side families, labeled:** ambient-priming is F3-stigmergic's read-half; reconstructive warming is F5's. The creation/use boundary otherwise holds row by row (every claim below is a how-it-reaches-attention claim, never a storage shape).

- **One exclusion, conjunct named:** spaced re-exposure/rehearsal — a stateless-session practice has no retaining subject between exposures; its time-trigger kernel lives inside push-driven's rhythm half.

- **Coverage honesty:** this is a strong sweep assembled by a traverse, not a proven-complete enumeration — the persisted `/paradigm-sweeper` run (with seed-blocks) is the completeness pass, routed on your word.

## Finding

### 1. The map

*Per row: the claim (how the past reaches attention) · exemplar · status · the house's position.*

**YOU READ IT**

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U1 | **Full-replay** | The whole past reaches you raw, in order — completeness over cost | onboarding-by-reading-everything | est (elsewhere) | **rejected** — killed by arithmetic (34k lines) |
| U2 | **Compressed-surface** | The settled past reaches you as artifacts built for reading — awareness per line | dashboards; sitreps; **the digest + views** | est | **occupied** — the warm-up's spine *(the protocol + read-doctrine findings)* |
| U3 | **Curriculum / guided tour** | The past reaches you as an ORDERED PATH authored for comprehension | onboarding docs; textbooks | est (elsewhere) / frontier here | one rule only (direction→views→frontier); no authored tours |

**YOU PULL IT**

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U4 | **Query-driven** | The relevant past reaches you when you ASK — search at need, nothing standing | grep habits; RAG; reference desks | est | **occupied + forced** — surfacing re-greps every inquiry *(the /traverse spec)* |
| U5 | **Index-first** | The past reaches you through MAPS — navigate structure, then drill by pointer | route-maps; `_route.md`; card catalogs | est | **occupied** — pointers everywhere *(the routelister layer)* |

**IT SITS WITH YOU** *(the passivities — differing in WHERE)*

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U6 | **Standing surface** *(in-window)* | Loaded-once material reaches you by ATTENTION — salience fires mid-work, unasked | the full-read warm-up; a pilot's instrument scan | est (just designed) | **occupied** — the associative surface *(the feasibility finding)* |
| U7 | **Ambient priming** *(in-territory; F3's read-half, as U11 is F5's)* | The workplace itself reaches you — marks and structure read in passing, no read-act | the ✓ columns; convention-heavy codebases | weak est | **occupied weakly** — marks exist; structure teaches little yet |

**IT COMES TO YOU**

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U8 | **Push-driven** | The past reaches you UNINVITED — watchers and triggers interrupt when relevance fires | reminders; CI alerts | **frontier** | **THE empty seat** — canon: "nothing watches between inquiries yet"; SUSTRALL's watcher |
| U9 | **Anticipatory prefetch** | The PREDICTED-relevant past reaches you before you ask *(prediction, not watching)* | OS prefetch; a chief-of-staff's morning brief | frontier | none — the tiers are fixed recipes, not predictions |

**ANOTHER MIND HOLDS IT**

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U10 | **Oracle recall** | The past reaches you by ASKING A KEEPER who holds it — conversational memory | team historians; **you (Level-0)**; the canon navigation-session role | est (human) / frontier (session) | **occupied by you** *(the north star)*; the session-oracle seat canon-defined, unbuilt |

**YOU REBUILD IT**

| # | Family | The claim | Exemplar | Status | House-position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U11 | **Reconstructive warming** *(F5's read-half, imported)* | The past reaches you by RE-DERIVATION — re-read the primary, rebuild the understanding | warming ceremonies; re-proving a theorem | doctrine, unpracticed | committed, never run *(the lifecycle finding)* |

### 2. The composite (where the design actually sits)

The current design spans **U2 + U4 + U5 + U6 fully, U10's human half, U11 as doctrine, one U3 rule, and weak U7** — eight touches across six clusters. This is why "should we switch paradigms?" is the wrong question shape: there is no single incumbent. The workable questions are per-seat: *which occupied seats underperform* (e.g., U7's structure-teaches-little), and *which empty seats would pay* (§3).

### 3. The empty seats (the use-side's open field)

1. **U8 push-driven** — the seat canon itself names empty: a watcher interrupting sessions (or you) when new work touches old constraints. SUSTRALL's traversal memory is its designed occupant.
2. **U9 prefetch** — warm-ups chosen by predicted task instead of fixed tier: "today you're consolidating X — here is X's view, its open routes, its two contested chains."
3. **U10-session** — the navigation-session oracle: an isolated session that HOLDS the cross-run picture and answers workers' questions (canon-defined, unbuilt; its first probe is the routed cold run).
4. **U3-authored** — a real onboarding tour: an ordered reading path for comprehension of the whole project.

### 4. The exclusion

**Spaced re-exposure / rehearsal** — excluded, failed conjunct named: no retaining subject between exposures in a stateless-session practice; its time-trigger kernel lives inside U8's rhythm half.

### 5. The boundary note

Every claim above is a USE-claim — how the past reaches attention — never a storage shape; the creation side has its own 8-family map (`devdocs/sweeps/traversal-memory/paradigm_sweep.md`). Two families straddle by construction and are labeled: U7 (F3's read-half) and U11 (F5's). **This list is a strong sweep assembled by a traverse, not a proven-complete enumeration** — the persisted sweeper run is the completeness pass.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** the creation-side sweep's 8 families (the complement boundary).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/sweeps/traversal-memory/paradigm_sweep.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — boundary confirmed, with TWO straddles found and labeled. **Evidence:** every row prosecuted for smuggled storage-shape at critique; F3 and F5 both carry read-halves by their own bundles ("read in-place"; "rebuild at read") — imported here as U7/U11 with symmetric labels; no other leakage.

- **Commitment:** the shipped use-machinery (tiers; salience; forced re-derivation; the human's share).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_13-10__isolated_session_feasibility_holistic_and_spontaneous/finding.md` and the chain behind it.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — placements verified. **Evidence:** every composite placement cites its committing source (the citations checked real at critique); the design placed as a composite, never a pin.

## Next Actions

### MUST

*(None — the list is the deliverable.)*

### COULD

- **What:** the persisted sweeper run — `/paradigm-sweeper` on "traversal-memory USE practice," this finding as warm input, emitting `devdocs/sweeps/traversal-memory-use/paradigm_sweep.md` (probes 0–5; seed-blocks; the completeness pass).
  **Who:** the AI, one run.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your word.
  **Why:** the creation/use pair complete, both sweeper-grade with copy-pasteable seeds.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** seat-dives for the uncarried seats (prefetch; authored tours).
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your pick (push is SUSTRALL's; the session-oracle's first probe is the routed cold run).
  **Why (if revived):** a seat's shape known before anyone builds it.

## Reasoning

**Why 11 and not 4:** the merge-everything steelman ("query/index/push/prefetch = one retrieval family parameterized by initiator") lost on the membership test's generative-capacity conjunct — the four build different things and fail differently (unasked questions / stale maps / alert fatigue / wrong guesses); its kernel survives as the cluster presentation. **Why 11 and not 12:** spaced re-exposure failed a conjunct (no retaining subject) and was excluded with it named, not silently dropped. **Why the delivery-mode axis:** "how does the past reach the present?" partitions the field into six mutually intelligible clusters and doubles as the list's mnemonic.

**Kills and refinements under critique:** the AMBIENT grab-bag worry (resolved: one cluster, two WHEREs); the F3 straddle found (U7 labeled); U9's prediction-not-watching clause; the coverage-theater guard; the ranking guard on the mnemonic.

## Open Questions

### Monitoring

### Refinement Triggers

# Finding: Push Without a Daemon — the U8 Seat's Mechanism and Its Option-Space

## Changes from Prior

**Prior path:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_14-11__traversal_memory_use_side_paradigms/finding.md`
**Revision trigger:** the user's dive request on the U8 row — how can push-driven memory be POSSIBLE here, and what option/method variations exist?
**What's preserved:** the use-side map whole; U8's row (claim, status, the seat).
**What's new:** the seat's mechanism (push-without-a-daemon), the four-axis option-space, four stackable archetypes with walls applied, and five critique-earned enforcement lines.
**Migration:** none — occupancy stays the user's choice; two small riders route to the build.

## Question

From `_branch.md`: *"Dive deeper into U8 push-driven — how can this be possible, and what option/method variations can it have?"*

## Finding Summary

- **Push needs no daemon, because "a watcher" decomposes into three parts this house already has:** a **CHECK** computable from artifacts (scripts for countables; sessions for meaning), a **MOMENT** it rides instead of residing (five fire-able moments exist on this machine today — warm-up boundaries, git events, cron schedules, session-start hooks, your device — zero currently wired), and an **INTERRUPT** that outlives its maker, materialized as a dated alert-note or delivered at a genuinely interruptive grain.

- **"Uninvited" survives materialization because of the initiation-locus:** the content chose ITSELF — relevance fired before any reader existed; the reader's question played no part. Two honest namings from the strongest counter-argument: an alerts-only design is *push-initiated, pull-delivered* (a hybrid, said plainly); and **the exact ceiling — nothing can break into a working session mid-thought.** Interruption granularity is session-birth (banner), tool-boundary (wired hooks), or your pocket (a real notification) — never finer.

- **The option-space is four axes:** MOMENT (boundary / event / schedule; threshold rides any; human-fired ≈ pull) × CHECKER (script / session / hybrid — scripts watch numbers, sessions read meaning, hybrid rations the expensive one) × CHECK-CONTENT (countable: frontier growth, view staleness, routes aging, chain-quiet · semantic: collisions, contradictions, relitigation-in-progress) × DELIVERY (conditional header line / dated alert-note / session-start banner / device notification / blocking gate — named the fatigue cliff).

- **Four coherent archetypes, stackable, never selected:** the **Warm-up Sentinel** (boundary·script·header lines — ~free; half-shipped), the **Landing Check** (event·script — one wired hook), the **Nightly Sweeper** (guard-gated cron·hybrid·alert-notes — the purest "uninvited"; the semantic home), the **Deep Auditor** (sparse cron·session·device-for-graves — the slow-rot hunter). Anti-bundles named: session-on-every-event; blocking+low-precision; notifications for non-graves.

- **The gauge→watcher gradient (a reusable membership test):** an always-printed line is instrumentation — the reader initiated; a CONDITIONAL line is U8 — the threshold decided. Membership lives exactly where output goes conditional.

- **Alert-notes are view-class, homed at `devdocs/alerts/<date>.md`** (critique moved them OUT of the views tree — a placement contradiction caught): dated, pointed, quoted-basis, subordinate, never edited; **acknowledged by WINDOW** (the warm-up reads alerts newer than K days — no marker, no state file; graves ride the device grain instead). Zero new maintained artifacts.

- **The walls, enforceable at the letter:** the valve with the terminal line (*"the sweep session ENDS at note-writing — its last act is the note"*); pre-registration via **the wall-sentence** (*"watchers report what the territory shows; they never record what anyone chose about it"*); thresholds as **spec constants** (*never adjusted by a watcher about itself*); and the **volume cap** (~3 alert-notes/day, overflow → one summary-note; ≤5 header lines; device once-per-grave).

## Finding

### 1. How push is possible here (the mechanism)

The contradiction is only apparent. "Something watches" does not require something RUNNING. A watcher decomposes into a check, a moment, and an interrupt — and all three exist in a sessions-and-files world. The CHECK computes from artifacts: frontier counts, staleness deltas, and aging routes are greps; collisions and contradictions need a reading session. The MOMENT is ridden, not resided-in: every warm-up is a moment; a git hook makes any landing a moment; a cron entry makes any night a moment. The INTERRUPT outlives its maker by becoming an artifact — a dated note whose reading is a mandatory warm-up step — or by landing at one of the three genuinely interruptive grains: a session's first tokens (banner), a tool-boundary (wired hooks), or your device (a real notification).

What makes this PUSH rather than elaborate pull is the initiation-locus: in every pull family, the reader's question selects the content; here the content selected itself — a threshold crossed, a collision found — before any reader existed. The strongest counter ("this is polling with extra steps") wins two concessions worth keeping: alert-notes-only designs are honestly *push-initiated, pull-delivered*; and the ceiling is exact — no external relevance can interrupt a working session mid-thought, ever, in this architecture.

### 2. The variations (the four axes)

| Axis | Options |
|---|---|
| **MOMENT** | boundary-fired (every warm-up) · event-fired (git/file hooks) · schedule-fired (cron, guard-gated) · [threshold = sub-mode riding any] · [human-fired = boundary case ≈ pull] |
| **CHECKER** | script (greps; cheap; countables) · session (reads meaning; expensive) · hybrid (scripts gate the session) |
| **CHECK-CONTENT** | countable: frontier growth · view staleness · open-routes aging · chain-quiet — semantic: new-vs-old collisions · contradiction candidates · relitigation-in-progress |
| **DELIVERY** | conditional header line · dated alert-note (`devdocs/alerts/`, window-acknowledged) · SessionStart banner · device notification (graves only) · blocking gate (the fatigue cliff) |

### 3. The archetypes (coherent bundles — marked, never selected; they stack)

1. **The Warm-up Sentinel** — boundary · script · header lines. A gauge panel whose CONDITIONAL lines are the watcher (the gauge→watcher gradient). Catches countable drift. Costs ~nothing; zero wiring; half-shipped already (`frontier: N`).
2. **The Landing Check** — event · script · one line. Catches a new arrival breaking countable rules the moment it lands. Costs one wired hook.
3. **The Nightly Sweeper** — guard-gated cron · hybrid · alert-notes (+banner). Step 1 always: *did anything land since the last sweep?* — exits in seconds when quiet; the session reads only on change, and only the landed material against the constraints it touches. The purest "uninvited"; the semantic checks' home. Ends at note-writing, by its own terminal line.
4. **The Deep Auditor** — sparse cron · session · alert-notes + device-for-graves. Hunts slow rot (mandate-coverage decay; cross-month contradictions). Rationed by design; the only archetype allowed to reach your pocket.

**Anti-bundles:** session-grade on every event (expensive noise) · blocking gates with low-precision checks (the fatigue cliff) · device pushes for non-graves (trust-spending). **Stacking:** the four ride different moments and share the alerts home — all four can coexist; which (if any) runs first is your pick.

### 4. The walls (every variation bound)

1. **The valve:** watchers RECOMMEND — they write notes; they never open inquiries, run ceremonies, generate views, or edit protocols. Session-grade watchers carry the terminal line verbatim: *the sweep session ends at note-writing; its last act is the note.*
2. **Pre-registration:** watcher outputs are view-class — dated, pointed, quoted-basis, subordinate, regenerated-never-edited — homed at `devdocs/alerts/` (outside the views tree; critique's placement catch). **The wall-sentence: watchers report what the territory shows; they never record what anyone chose about it.** A collision-note passes; a pursue/dismiss record is the write-half — the user's open decision, untouched by this design.
3. **Fatigue:** precision before recall; thresholds are protocol constants (set at build, changed by you, never self-adjusted); the volume cap (~3 notes/day, overflow → one summary-note; ≤5 header lines; device once-per-grave); acknowledgment by window (K days), not mechanics.

### 5. The two worked paths (illustration, not selection)

**Cheapest — the Sentinel (zero wiring):** the digest header, which the build already carries, gains `stalest-view: <concept> (<days>d behind)` and `aging-routes: <n> open >30d`; each line has a conditional form that fires past its spec-constant threshold. Nothing else — no files, no state, everything derived per run.

**Purest — the Sweeper (one cron session):** (1) the guard: anything landed since the last sweep-mark? quiet → exit in seconds; (2) on change: run the countable greps, then read ONLY the landed findings' summaries against the old constraints they touch; (3) each real find → `devdocs/alerts/<date>.md` (pointer + one line + quoted basis; no selections recorded); (4) the next warm-up reads alerts newer than K days; a banner can surface the newest line if hooks are wired. Ends at the note.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** the U8 row (claim; frontier; the seat) + the U8/U9 boundary (watching ≠ prediction) + the family's failure mode (fatigue).
  - **Source:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_14-11__traversal_memory_use_side_paradigms/finding.md`.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — confirmed and sharpened. **Evidence:** reactive-only verified per archetype at critique (every check reads what EXISTS — landed findings, recorded kills, history — nothing infers a future task); the fatigue wall gained the QUANTITY bound critique showed missing (the map had guarded quality only); the gauge→watcher gradient LOCATES U8-membership precisely (conditional output), strengthening the row's boundary.

- **Commitment:** the valve (sessions never self-initiate ceremonies/builds; the number is for the user's eyes) + the one-invocation architecture.
  - **Source:** the read-doctrine + feasibility findings (`2026-07-03_11-00`, `13-10`).
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — confirmed and FORECLOSED IN WORDS. **Evidence:** the recommend→act slide was prosecuted at the Sweeper (the most tempted archetype) and closed with the terminal line in the recipe itself; thresholds made spec-constants so no watcher adjusts its own trigger.

- **Commitment:** pre-registration physics (the indicator file predates the first trace; views are derived, not traces).
  - **Source:** the memory chain (standing).
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — honored via the view-class adjudication. **Evidence:** the sharpest case (a session-grade collision-note) adjudicated with the class's own mechanism — derived-from-artifacts + dated + pointed + quoted-basis + regenerable = view-class (the views precedent settles that curation-judgment doesn't disqualify); anything recording a CHOICE is trace-class and excluded by the wall-sentence; the placement bug (alerts inside the views tree) caught and fixed (`devdocs/alerts/`).

## Next Actions

### MUST

*(None — the dive's answer is the deliverable; occupancy is your choice.)*

### COULD

- **What:** the Sentinel lines ride the protocol build (sixth enrichment) — the two header lines + conditional forms + the walls' three lines where the header is specified.
  **Who:** the AI, within the same build.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your word (`[∥]` the protocol map's build route).
  **Why:** the cheapest archetype live the day the protocol ships; zero wiring.

- **What:** the first watcher wiring — you pick an archetype (they stack; which FIRST is the pick): Sweeper (cron + guard + `devdocs/alerts/`), Landing Check (one git hook), or Deep Auditor (sparse cron + device-for-graves).
  **Who:** the AI wires on your pick.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your pick.
  **Why:** the seat genuinely occupied; the first real uninvited arrival.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** the SUSTRALL watcher build-out (the seat's canonical occupant).
  **Gate:** the roadmap's own program (`[∥ 18-48]`); this dive FEEDS its design (mechanism + walls transfer).
  **Why (if revived):** the watcher grows the system's share of the standing watch — the ladder's next rung.

## Reasoning

**Why the mechanism leads:** the user's "how can this be possible?" is the load-bearing half — without the decomposition (check + moment + interrupt) the variations read as fantasy; with it, every option grounds in a moment this machine already has.

**Why archetypes instead of a recommendation:** the enumerate-don't-select posture, and honestly — the archetypes stack, so "which" is really "which first," a rhythm-and-budget choice that is yours.

**Significant kills and catches:** the root `_inbox.md` (a new maintained artifact — dissolved into dated view-class notes with window-acknowledgment); the alerts-inside-views placement (a planted contradiction — moved to `devdocs/alerts/`); the which-previous-session marker (hidden state — dissolved into a K-day window); the unguarded nightly session (cost — the guard step); the self-tuning threshold (valve-adjacent — spec constants); unbounded volume (the ~3/day cap with overflow-summary).

## Open Questions

### Monitoring
- If/when the first watcher runs: does the volume cap hold on active days, and do alert-notes actually get read within their window (the memory-iff-read test, on alerts)?

### Blocked
- All wiring — blocked on your archetype pick and the build word, by design.

### Refinement Triggers
- If alerts age out unread repeatedly → the window is wrong or the notes aren't earning reads (precision audit before widening anything).
- If a session-grade watcher's notes drift toward evaluative language → the register rule applies to alerts too (functional, never persuasive).

# Finding: Why Traversal Memory — the Grounding Document (Attributes → Capabilities → the Goal)

## Changes from Prior

**Prior path:** `devdocs/inquiries/2026-07-03_16-39__push_driven_memory_mechanisms_dive/finding.md` (the chain's latest).
**Revision trigger:** the user's "before anything" ask — the WHY beneath the whole memory program, in human language, with the human brain as the sample.
**What's preserved:** every design in the chain, untouched — this finding grounds them; it changes nothing.
**What's new:** the justification narrative; five user stories; the 11-attribute → capability → goal-phase mapping; the honest notes (brain-differences; gaps-as-roadmap).
**Migration:** none. (Canonization to `docs/canon/` is a routed option, on your word.)

## Question

From `_branch.md`: **I1** — *why is traversal memory important for us? What capabilities does it allow — with example user stories.* **I2** — *which attribute of our traversal-memory definition corresponds to what capability, toward our end goal?* Both in human-understandable language, with human-brain memory as the sample.

## Finding Summary

- **The one-line why: traversal memory is how this project stops paying a human to be its hippocampus.** Today every session is born knowing nothing, and you are the memory — canon names the cost verbatim: *"the documented Level-0 failure mode is operator fatigue."*

- **The goal's own metric is a memory metric.** The primary objective — the self-improvement rate — asks four questions, and **three of the four are memory questions outright**: a system that can't remember can't notice it needs to improve (*Trigger*, today ≈0% system-detected — canon: "nothing watches between inquiries yet"), can't reach working state fast (*Speed*), can't keep what it learned (*Retention*). The fourth, *Magnitude*, is memory-FED: how much a cycle improves is reasoning's work, but compounding requires the lessons within reach.

- **Eleven attributes in four human jobs**, each with its brain-sample: **RECORD** what happened (act-lines ↔ the Paris evening — episodic); **READ** what's true (summaries ↔ knowing-without-the-classroom; views ↔ morning-knowledge; the frontier ↔ papers still on the desk; pointers ↔ the brain stores WHERE, not copies; sweeps ↔ the smell that brings back the kitchen); **DIGEST** as you go (ceremonies ↔ the night replay; the trail ↔ updating without forgetting the old address); **NOTICE** without being asked (the warm-up surface ↔ a face lighting up; watchers ↔ milk when passing the store; route-maps ↔ the errand list for future-you).

- **The statuses are honest and the gaps are the roadmap:** 4 built (summaries 96% coverage · pointers/✓ · sweeps · route-maps 26 live), 6 designed (one build away), 1 open (act-lines — your decision). The two capabilities the goal's metric needs most are exactly the unserved ones: **NOTICING** (why Trigger sits at ≈0%) and **RECORDING JUDGMENT** (the only attribute feeding the Level gates — canon: *"Every human judgment recorded along the way IS the training data for the system's future quality awareness"*).

- **The analogy is honest about breaking in three places:** brains forget usefully — and the design does too, on the read path only (superseded findings shrink to a line; storage keeps everything — the safer half of forgetting); brains generalize automatically — here only ceremonies generalize (a real half-gap); brains' salience is lifetime-trained — here the trained salience is YOURS at Level 0, and moving shares of it to the system is what the whole ladder means.

## Finding

### 1. Why — the amnesia, the fatigue, the goal

Picture tomorrow morning. You open a session and it knows nothing — not what was decided yesterday, not which ideas died in June and why, not where the project is heading. Everything it will know about this project in the next five minutes is what YOU carry to it. You paste, you summarize, you remember for it. You are the memory. Every session, again.

The project's own canon names the price: *"the documented Level-0 failure mode is operator fatigue."* Not bad output — fatigue. The system survives only while you keep carrying it, and the carrying is the thing most likely to end the project.

Now look at what the project is FOR. The north star's primary measured objective is the **self-improvement rate**, asked as four plain questions: **Trigger** — does the system know it needs to improve? **Speed** — how fast from noticing to an encoded fix? **Magnitude** — how much improves per cycle? **Retention** — do improvements stick? Canon's honest baseline: the system detects **≈0%** of its own improvement triggers — *"nothing watches between inquiries yet."* Three of those four are memory questions outright — a system that can't remember can't notice, can't reach working state fast, can't keep what it learned. The fourth is memory-fed: the SIZE of an improvement is reasoning's work, but compounding requires the lessons within reach.

That is why traversal memory comes before anything: it is the program of moving memory-functions, one at a time, out of your head and into artifacts the system reads and moments the system rides — the way a brain doesn't ask its owner to keep notes, because remembering, digesting, and noticing are functions of the system itself.

### 2. Five stories

**1. The idea that stayed dead** *(anti-relitigation — the trail + summaries).* Before: three months from now a fresh session proposes "a tenth thinking discipline," nobody remembers it was killed in July, and a whole loop is spent re-discovering the kill. After: the killed idea sits in every relevant view as one tagged line, and the new proposal meets its own grave at warm-up. It already happened once with warm context — the paradigm-sweeper design re-tested a same-day kill instead of re-inventing it. Traversal memory makes cold sessions able to do what warm ones did by luck.

**2. The three-minute morning** *(cold-start continuity — tiers + frontier + views).* Before: whole-project awareness costs a 34,000-line read nobody can afford, so sessions start narrow and you fill the gaps by hand. After *(one build away)*: a session reads direction, the settled story, and the live edge in ~3,000 lines — the way you wake up knowing your life without replaying it — and asks you nothing it could have read.

**3. Twelve findings become one page** *(trajectory intelligibility — ceremonies + supersession).* Before: "what did we actually decide about routelister?" means archaeology across twelve findings. After *(designed; one build away)*: you say "stabilize routelister"; the system replays the topic's history into one consolidation finding — like a night's sleep turning a scattered day into something you just KNOW in the morning — and the topic's view opens with it.

**4. The note that was waiting** *(unprompted noticing — watchers + alerts; designed, not built).* Before: yesterday's finding quietly contradicts a constraint from May, and it stays quiet until something breaks. After: at your next warm-up a dated note is waiting — "yesterday's X touches May's Y — see both" — the way you remember the milk WHEN you pass the store, not because anyone asked.

**5. The system that learns your judgment** *(selection-calibration — act-lines; FUTURE tense, honestly: this rests on the one attribute still open).* Before: you pick routes every day and the reasons evaporate; the system can never learn what you would choose. After months of one-line records — `chose R2 · because cheap-first → …` — the system starts predicting your picks, and canon says exactly what that buys: *"Every human judgment recorded along the way IS the training data for the system's future quality awareness."* That data is the ladder out of Level 0 — toward the Level gates (the evidence thresholds for handing the system more autonomy) — and it does not exist until the recording starts.

### 3. The table — eleven attributes, four jobs

*(Scenes lead; terms decorate. Status: **built** = running today · **designed** = spec-ready, one build away · **open** = your decision pending.)*

**RECORDING what happened — so the past can teach.**

| Attribute | Like the brain's… | What it buys | Goal-phase | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| act-lines + meant-lines (`chose · because → destination`) | the Paris evening — what you did and why *(episodic)* | learn from choices; feed the Level gates | *"judgments recorded… ARE the training data"* + Retention | **open** |

**READING what's true — so awareness stays affordable.**

| Attribute | Like the brain's… | What it buys | Goal-phase | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finding Summaries | knowing Paris is France's capital without the classroom *(semantic)* | grasp any finding in ~20 lines | Speed + fatigue | **built** (96% coverage) |
| views + digest + read-tiers | the organized knowledge a night's sleep leaves *(consolidation's product)* | whole-project awareness at a tenth the cost | Speed + fatigue | designed |
| the frontier, read raw | the papers still on the desk, not yet filed *(working memory)* | the live edge always fresh, never compressed | Speed | designed |
| pointers + ✓ marks | the brain stores WHERE, not copies *(the hippocampal index)* | drill anything; duplicate nothing | Speed + fatigue | **built** |
| per-question sweeps | the smell that brings back the kitchen *(cued recall)* | re-derive the relevant past at need | Trigger (per-question) | **built** |

**DIGESTING as you go — so lessons compound instead of pile.**

| Attribute | Like the brain's… | What it buys | Goal-phase | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| stabilization ceremonies | the night replay that files the day *(sleep consolidation)* | N findings → one truth; the encode step | Retention (*"do improvements stick?"*) | designed |
| the closed trail | your friend moved; you update WITHOUT forgetting the old address *(reconsolidation)* | kills stay dead; corrections keep their history | Retention | designed |

**NOTICING without being asked — so relevance finds YOU.**

| Attribute | Like the brain's… | What it buys | Goal-phase | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| the warm-up salience surface | a face lighting up in a crowd *(recognition)* | old details fire mid-work, unasked | Trigger (in-session) | designed |
| watchers + alert-notes | remembering milk WHEN passing the store *(prospective memory)* | the system notices between sessions | **Trigger** (*"does the system know it needs to improve?"* — today ≈0%) | designed |
| route-maps + `_route.md` | the errand list you wrote for future-you *(prospective intentions)* | direction survives the gap between sessions | Speed + Retention | **built** (26 maps live) |

### 4. The honest notes

**Where the analogy breaks, said plainly.** Brains forget usefully; we never delete — but the design forgets on the READ path (a superseded finding shrinks to one line, then a count) while storage remembers everything: arguably the safer half of forgetting. Brains generalize across episodes automatically; here only a consolidation ceremony generalizes — a real half-gap, named. And a brain's salience is trained by a lifetime while ours is loaded fresh each warm-up — at Level 0 that is by design: the lifetime-trained salience in this architecture is YOURS, and moving shares of it to the system is what the whole ladder means.

**The gaps are the roadmap.** Count the table: four built, six designed and one build away, one open — and the two capabilities the goal's own metric needs most are exactly the unserved ones. NOTICING is paper, which is why Trigger sits at ≈0%. RECORDING JUDGMENT is your open decision, and it is the only attribute that feeds the Level gates. The read side is a build away from done; the frontier of this program is the watcher and the write-half.

## Inherited Commitments Re-test

- **Commitment:** canon's objective (the four phases; the ≈0% baseline; the calibration line; the fatigue line; the Level ladder).
  - **Source:** `docs/canon/project_north_star.md` (read at the letter this inquiry).
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — quoted, not paraphrased; one linkage TRIMMED under prosecution. **Evidence:** the four phases appear as canon words them; the Magnitude claim was caught overclaiming ("a memory question") and corrected to memory-FED — three-plus-one, the honest shape.

- **Commitment:** the chain's attribute inventory with statuses (the 9 findings from 06-22 through 16-39 + the built practices).
  - **Source:** the memory chain's findings, each cited in its row.
  - **Re-test status:** RE-TESTED — all eleven rows cite real committing sources; statuses verified with figures (96% coverage; 26 maps; 120/46 frontier behind A4; the OPEN write-half); one attribute ADDED for faithfulness (per-question sweeps — built and running in every traverse; omitting it would have understated the built stock).

## Next Actions

### MUST

*(None — the grounding is the deliverable.)*

### COULD

- **What:** canonize — distill this finding into `docs/canon/why_traversal_memory.md` (self-contained: no inquiry refs in the body), joining the direction layer the full-read's step 0 reads.
  **Who:** the AI, one pass.
  **Gate:** condition-bound — your word.
  **Why:** a grounding that lives in one finding among 400 isn't ground; in canon, every cold session warms up knowing WHY.

### DEFERRED

- **What:** seed the first onboarding tour from this finding (the authored-tour seat's first chapter: why the project → why memory → how a traverse runs → where things live).
  **Gate:** condition-bound — if tours are wanted.
  **Why (if revived):** the cheapest probe of an empty seat, from a real seed.

*(The two GAPS route to their existing owners: the watcher wiring `[∥ 16-39 R2]`; the write-half `[∥ 00-53 R1]` — this finding is their WHY, not a new route.)*

## Reasoning

**Why baseline-first:** the user asked "why important FOR US" — the felt pain (the amnesiac morning; canon's own fatigue line) is the hook a stranger understands before any architecture; the goal supplies the stakes; the stories cash the claims.

**Why scenes lead and terms decorate:** the mandated inversion — neuroscience vocabulary taxes the readability the analogies exist to serve; "the milk when passing the store" teaches prospective memory better than the term does.

**Significant kills and trims:** the flat-11 table (→ four function-groups); term-led analog column (→ scene-led); the Magnitude overclaim (→ memory-fed); tense-ambiguity in stories 2–3 (→ "one build away" markers); the unglossed "Level gates" (→ glossed); status bare-words (→ figures attached).

## Open Questions

### Monitoring
- Does a genuinely fresh reader (or cold session) actually follow the narrative without stumbling? (The first canonization or tour-read is the test.)

### Refinement Triggers
- When the watcher or the write-half lands → update the statuses (the table's honesty is dated to today: 4/6/1).
- If canonized → the canon copy follows the self-contained rule; regenerating it from an updated finding is the maintenance path.
